pokemon.name: Paldean Tauros Aqua Breed
pokemon.nameZh: 肯泰羅（帕底亞的樣子・水瀾種）

pokemon.name: Paldean Tauros Blaze Breed
pokemon.nameZh: 肯泰羅（帕底亞的樣子・火熾種）

pokemon.name: Paldean Tauros Combat Breed
pokemon.nameZh: 肯泰羅（帕底亞的樣子・鬥戰種）

moves.name: Accelerock
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 迅速撞向對手進行攻擊。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

moves.name: Acid Armor
moves.description: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 藉由細胞的變化讓身體液化， 大幅提高自己的防禦。

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 噴出能溶化對手的液體進行攻擊。 可大幅降低對手的特防。

moves.name: Acrobatics
moves.description: Power doubles if the user has no held item.
moves.descriptionZh: 輕巧地攻擊對手。 自己沒有攜帶道具時， 能給予對手較大的傷害。

moves.name: Acupressure
moves.description: Raises a random stat by 2 stages as long as the stat is not already at stage 6. The user can choose to use this move on itself or an adjacent ally. Fails if no stat stage can be raised or if used on an ally with a substitute.
moves.descriptionZh: 利用點穴激發身體的活力， 大幅提高某一項能力。

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: This move does not check accuracy.
moves.descriptionZh: 以敏捷的動作 戲弄對手後進行切斬。 攻擊必定會命中。

moves.name: After You
moves.description: The target makes its move immediately after the user this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target would have moved next anyway, or if the target already moved this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 支援對手， 讓對手緊接在自己之後行動。

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 放鬆身體， 讓自己變得輕盈以進行高速移動。 可大幅提高自己的速度。

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 用鋒利的風刃 斬切對手進行攻擊。 容易擊中要害。

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 用連天空也能劈開的 空氣之刃進行攻擊。 有時會使對手畏縮。

moves.name: Alluring Voice
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果目標本回合提升了統計等級，則有 100% 的幾率迷惑目標。

moves.name: Ally Switch
moves.description: The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.
moves.descriptionZh: 用神奇的力量瞬間移動， 讓自己和同伴的所在位置互換。

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.description: Raises the user's Special Defense by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 將頭腦清空， 藉由在一瞬間遺忘某些事 大幅提高自己的特防。

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 用原始之力進行攻擊。 有時會提高 自己的所有能力。

moves.name: Apple Acid
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 100%機率降低目標特防1級。

moves.name: Aqua Cutter
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 造成暴擊的幾率更高。

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 以迅雷不及掩耳之勢 撲向對手。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

moves.name: Aqua Ring
moves.description: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn while it remains active. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will receive the healing effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 在自己的身邊套上水流環。 每回合會回復自己的ＨＰ。

moves.name: Aqua Step
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 100%機率使用戶速度提升1級。

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 如驚濤駭浪般地甩動 大尾巴攻擊對手。

moves.name: Armor Cannon
moves.description: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 使自身防禦、特防降低1級。

moves.name: Aromatic Mist
moves.description: Raises the target's Special Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
moves.descriptionZh: 利用神奇的芳香， 提高我方寶可夢的特防。

moves.name: Assurance
moves.description: Power doubles if the target has already taken damage this turn, other than direct damage from Belly Drum, confusion, Curse, or Pain Split.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果此回合內對手 已受到傷害， 招式威力會變成２倍。

moves.name: Astonish
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 用巨大的聲響等 突然驚嚇對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手畏縮。

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: Causes the target to become infatuated, making it unable to attack 50% of the time. Fails if both the user and the target are the same gender, if either is genderless, or if the target is already infatuated. The effect ends when either the user or the target is no longer active. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.
moves.descriptionZh: ♂誘惑♀而♀誘惑♂， 讓對手著迷。 對手將難以使用招式。

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.description: This move does not check accuracy.
moves.descriptionZh: 將來自體內深處的波導之力 擊向對手。 攻擊必定會命中。

moves.name: Aura Wheel
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage. If the user is a Morpeko in Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. If the user is a Morpeko in Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Full Belly or Hangry Mode Morpeko.
moves.descriptionZh: 用儲存在頰囊中的能量進行攻擊， 並提高自己的速度。招式屬性 會隨著莫魯貝可的樣子而改變。

moves.name: Aurora Veil
moves.description: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Snow.
moves.descriptionZh: 在５回合內減弱 物理和特殊的傷害。 在下冰雹時才有效果。

moves.name: Autotomize
moves.description: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages. If the user's Speed was changed, the user's weight is reduced by 100 kg as long as it remains active. This effect is stackable but cannot reduce the user's weight to less than 0.1 kg.
moves.descriptionZh: 削去身體上多餘的部分。 以大幅提高自己的速度， 同時體重也會變輕。

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: Power doubles if the user was hit by the target this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果受到對手的招式攻擊， 給予該對手的招式威力就會變成２倍。

moves.name: Axe Kick
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.
moves.descriptionZh: 有30%的幾率迷惑目標。如果這次攻擊不成功，使用者會損失最大生命值的一半，向下捨入，作為碰撞傷害。具有魔法守衛能力的神奇寶貝不受碰撞傷害的影響。

moves.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 用圓圓的眼睛凝視對手， 降低對手的攻擊。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

moves.name: Baneful Bunker
moves.description: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user become poisoned. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 在此回合中，用戶可以免受其他神奇寶貝的大多數攻擊，並且與用戶接觸的神奇寶貝會中毒。此動作有 1/X 的成功機會，其中 X 從 1 開始，每次成功使用此動作時 X 會增加三倍。如果此動作失敗，如果使用者使用的最後一個動作不是「Baneful Bunker」、「Burning Bulwark」、「Detect」、「Endure」、「King's Shield」、「Max Guard」、「Obstruct」、「Protect」、「Quick Guard」、「Silk Trap」、「Obstruct」、「Protect」、「Quick Guard」、「Sikylk Trap」、「Spiky Guard」或「Spiky Guard」，如果這些動作是「Spiky」，如果這些動作是「Spiky」，如果這些動作是「Spiky Guard」。如果用戶本回合最後移動則失敗。

moves.name: Barb Barrage
moves.description: Has a 50% chance to poison the target. Power doubles if the target is already poisoned.
moves.descriptionZh: 有50%的幾率使目標中毒。如果目標已經中毒，則力量加倍。

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party. The selected Pokemon has the user's stat stage changes transferred to it, as well as the effects of confusion, Aqua Ring, Curse, Dragon Cheer, Embargo, Focus Energy, Gastro Acid, Heal Block, Ingrain, Leech Seed, Lock-On (Mind Reader), Magnet Rise, Perish Song, Power Trick, Telekinesis, and a substitute with its remaining HP. The effect of Gastro Acid is not transferred if the recipient has an Ability that cannot be affected.
moves.descriptionZh: 與後備寶可夢進行替換。 替換上場的寶可夢， 將承接目前寶可夢的能力變化。

moves.name: Beak Blast
moves.description: If the user is hit by a contact move this turn before it can execute this move, the attacker is burned.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果使用者在本回合中在執行該移動之前被接觸移動擊中，則攻擊者會被燒傷。

moves.name: Beat Up
moves.description: Hits one time for the user and one time for each unfainted Pokemon without a non-volatile status condition in the user's party. The power of each hit is equal to 5+(X/10), where X is each participating Pokemon's base Attack; each hit is considered to come from the user.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓我方所有寶可夢進行攻擊。 同行的寶可夢越多， 招式的攻擊次數越多。

moves.name: Belch
moves.description: Fails unless the user has eaten a Berry, either by eating one that was held, stealing and eating one off another Pokemon with Bug Bite or Pluck, or eating one that was thrown at it with Fling. Once the condition is met, this move can be selected and used for the rest of the battle even if the user gains or uses another item or switches out. Consuming a Berry with Natural Gift does not count for the purposes of eating one.
moves.descriptionZh: 除非使用者吃掉了漿果，否則失敗，無論是吃掉持有的漿果，還是用蟲咬或拔取從另一個神奇寶貝身上偷走並吃掉一個漿果，或者吃掉用投擲扔向它的漿果。一旦滿足條件，即使使用者獲得或使用其他物品或切換出去，也可以選擇該動作並在剩餘的戰鬥中使用。食用具有自然天賦的莓果並不能算是食用莓果的目的。

moves.name: Belly Drum
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack by 12 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack stat stage is 6.
moves.descriptionZh: 將現有的ＨＰ 減去最大ＨＰ的一半， 讓自己的攻擊提高至最大值。

moves.name: Bind
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用長長的身體或藤蔓等， 在４～５回合內 綁緊對手進行攻擊。

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 用尖銳的牙齒 咬住對手進行攻擊。 有時會使對手畏縮。

moves.name: Bitter Blade
moves.description: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
moves.descriptionZh: 用戶恢復目標損失HP的1/2，四捨五入到一半。若使用者持有大根，HP恢復量為正常的1.3倍，四捨五入一半。

moves.name: Bitter Malice
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 100%機率使目標攻擊降低1級。

moves.name: Blast Burn
moves.description: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
moves.descriptionZh: 用爆炸的火焰 燒盡對手進行攻擊。 下一回合自己將無法動彈。

moves.name: Blaze Kick
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 有時會讓受到攻擊的對手 陷入灼傷狀態。 且容易擊中要害。

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.
moves.descriptionZh: 將猛烈的暴風雪 吹向對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入冰凍狀態。

moves.name: Block
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
moves.descriptionZh: 張開雙手進行阻擋， 封住對手的退路， 讓對手無法逃走。

moves.name: Body Press
moves.description: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes. Other effects that modify the Attack stat are used as normal.
moves.descriptionZh: 用身體撞向對手進行攻擊。 自己的防禦越高， 給予對手的傷害越大。

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
moves.descriptionZh: 用整個身體 壓住對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Bone Rush
moves.description: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
moves.descriptionZh: 擊打二到五次。有 35% 的幾率擊中 2 到 3 次，15% 的幾率擊中 4 到 5 次。如果其中一擊打壞了目標的替身，則其餘的擊中都會受到傷害。若使用者擁有技能連結能力，這招總會命中五次。如果使用者持有已載入的骰子，則該動作將擊中 4-5 次。

moves.name: Boomburst
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 利用震耳欲聾的爆炸聲 所產生的破壞力， 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。

moves.name: Bounce
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 彈跳到高空中， 在下一回合攻擊對手。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
moves.descriptionZh: 收起翅膀， 低空飛行突擊對手。 自己也會受到不小的傷害。

moves.name: Breaking Swipe
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 激烈地甩動強韌 的尾巴攻擊對手， 降低對手的攻擊。

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.
moves.descriptionZh: 猛烈地揮下手刀 攻擊對手。還可以破壞 光牆和反射壁等。

moves.name: Brine
moves.description: Power doubles if the target has less than or equal to half of its maximum HP remaining.
moves.descriptionZh: 當對手負傷， ＨＰ剩一半左右時， 招式威力會變成２倍。

moves.name: Brutal Swing
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 用自己的身體狂舞揮打， 給予對手傷害。

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 叮咬對手進行攻擊。 可以吃下對手攜帶的樹果， 並獲得樹果的效果。

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 利用振動產生出的音波進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的特防。

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 將力量集中於體內，增厚肌肉， 提高自己的攻擊和防禦。

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 用力踩踏地面， 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。 可降低對手的速度。

moves.name: Bullet Punch
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手連續揮出如子彈般 快速且堅硬的拳頭。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手猛烈地 發射種子進行攻擊。 連續攻擊２～５次。

moves.name: Burn Up
moves.description: Fails unless the user is a Fire type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Fire type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.
moves.descriptionZh: 燃盡全身的火焰， 給予對手巨大的傷害。 自己的火屬性將會消失。

moves.name: Burning Jealousy
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to burn the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 用嫉妒的能量攻擊對手。 讓此回合內能力提高的 寶可夢陷入灼傷狀態。

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 屏氣凝神， 提高自己的特攻和特防。

moves.name: Ceaseless Edge
moves.description: If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. A maximum of three layers may be set, and opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果此動作成功，則會在場地的另一側設置一個危險，對每個切換到的對方神奇寶貝造成傷害，除非它是飛行型神奇寶貝或具有懸浮能力。最多可設定三層，一層減少對手最大生命值的1/8，兩層減少對手最大生命值的1/6，三層減少對手最大生命值的1/4，四捨五入。如果任何神奇寶貝使用整理，或者任何對手神奇寶貝成功使用致命旋轉，快速旋轉或除霧，或者被除霧擊中，則可以從對手移除。

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: Raises the user's Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's next Electric-type attack will have its power doubled; the effect ends when the user is no longer active, or after the user attempts to use any Electric-type move besides Charge, even if it is not successful.
moves.descriptionZh: 提高下一回合使出的 電屬性招式威力。 也會提高自己的特防。

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: Has a 70% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發射電擊光束。 有時會因電流蓄積， 提高自己的特攻。

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 用撒嬌的眼神 誘使對手疏忽大意， 大幅降低對手的攻擊。

moves.name: Chilling Water
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 100%機率使目標攻擊降低1級。

moves.name: Chilly Reception
moves.description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. The user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.
moves.descriptionZh: 持續 5 回合，天氣變為雪。即使被困，用戶也會退出並立即由選定的黨員取代。如果沒有未暈倒的黨員，則使用者不會退出。

moves.name: Circle Throw
moves.description: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target is under the effect of Ingrain, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.
moves.descriptionZh: 摔飛對手， 強制讓後備寶可夢上場。 對手為野生寶可夢時，戰鬥將直接結束。

moves.name: Clanging Scales
moves.description: Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 摩擦全身鱗片， 發出響亮的聲音並進行攻擊。 攻擊後自己的防禦會降低。

moves.name: Clangorous Soul
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage in exchange for the user losing 33% of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stat stages would not change.
moves.descriptionZh: 使自身的攻擊、防禦、特攻、特防、速度提升1級，但會損失最大生命值的33%，向下取整。如果使用者暈倒或其攻擊、防禦、特攻、特防和速度統計階段不變，則失敗。

moves.name: Clear Smog
moves.description: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手投擲特殊的泥塊進行攻擊。 能讓對手的能力變化 回復到初始狀態。

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 反守為攻，近身突擊對手。 自己的防禦和特防會降低。

moves.name: Coaching
moves.description: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
moves.descriptionZh: 透過適切的指導， 提高我方全體的攻擊和防禦。

moves.name: Coil
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and accuracy by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 盤蜷身體集中精神。 可提高自己的攻擊、防禦和命中率。

moves.name: Comeuppance
moves.description: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 對本回合中最後一個以物理或特殊攻擊擊中用戶的敵方神奇寶貝造成傷害，傷害值等於用戶在該攻擊中損失的生命值的 1.5 倍，向下舍入。如果使用者沒有因該攻擊而損失生命值，則此招式會造成 1 點生命值傷害。如果對方寶可夢的位置不再使用，場上還有另一隻對方寶可夢，則會對其造成傷害。僅計算多重攻擊的最後一擊。如果用戶本回合沒有被對手神奇寶貝的物理或特殊攻擊擊中，則失敗。

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.description: Causes the target to become confused.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓對手看奇怪的光線 擾亂對手。 使對手混亂。

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發送 微弱的念力進行攻擊。 有時會使對手混亂。

moves.name: Copycat
moves.description: The user uses the last move used by any Pokemon, including itself. Fails if no move has been used, or if the last move used was Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dragon Tail, Dynamax Cannon, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.
moves.descriptionZh: 模仿對手最近一次使用的招式， 若對手沒有成功出招則會失敗。

moves.name: Corrosive Gas
moves.description: The target loses its held item. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item or cause a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon to lose their Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask, respectively. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 用強烈的酸性氣體 包圍周圍所有的寶可夢， 並將攜帶的道具融化掉。

moves.name: Cosmic Power
moves.description: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 吸取來自宇宙的神秘力量， 提高自己的防禦和特防。

moves.name: Cotton Guard
moves.description: Raises the user's Defense by 3 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 用軟綿綿的絨毛 保護自己的身體。 極大幅提高自己的防禦。

moves.name: Cotton Spore
moves.description: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 將棉花般柔軟的孢子 纏繞對手， 大幅降低對手的速度。

moves.name: Counter
moves.description: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical attack this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 將來自對手的物理攻擊傷害加倍後， 返還給該對手。

moves.name: Covet
moves.description: If this attack was successful and the user is not holding an item, it steals the target's held item. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mega Stone and either the user or the target is the species that can Mega Evolve with it. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 一邊可愛地撒嬌， 一邊靠近對手， 奪取對手攜帶的道具。

moves.name: Crabhammer
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 造成暴擊的幾率更高。

moves.name: Crafty Shield
moves.description: The user and its party members are protected from non-damaging attacks made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用神奇的力量 防禦住攻擊我方的變化招式。 但無法防禦住攻擊招式的攻擊。

moves.name: Cross Chop
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 用左右手刀 劈打對手進行攻擊。 容易擊中要害。

moves.name: Cross Poison
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to poison the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 用毒刃劈開對手。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態， 也容易擊中要害。

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 用尖銳的牙齒咬碎對手進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的防禦。

moves.name: Crush Claw
moves.description: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 有50%的幾率使目標防禦降低1級。

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: If the user is not a Ghost type, lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage and raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. If the user is a Ghost type, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down and even if it would cause fainting, in exchange for the target losing 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn while it is active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue to be affected. Fails if there is no target or if the target is already affected.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用詛咒時， 幽靈屬性的寶可夢和其他屬性的寶可夢， 會獲得不同的招式效果。

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 從身體散發出 充滿惡意的恐怖氣場。 有時會使對手畏縮。

moves.name: Darkest Lariat
moves.description: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.
moves.descriptionZh: 旋轉雙臂並打向對手。 可不顧對手的能力變化 給予傷害。

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 發出強烈的閃光， 給予對手傷害。

moves.name: Decorate
moves.description: Raises the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 透過裝飾， 大幅提高對手的 攻擊和特攻。

moves.name: Defog
moves.description: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 1 stage. If this move is successful and whether or not the target's evasiveness was affected, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, Mist, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the target's side, and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the user's side. Ignores a target's substitute, although a substitute will still block the lowering of evasiveness. If there is a terrain active and this move is successful, the terrain will be cleared.
moves.descriptionZh: 用強風吹開對手的 反射壁或光牆等。 也會降低對手的閃避率。

moves.name: Destiny Bond
moves.description: Until the user's next move, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that Pokemon faints as well, unless the attack was Doom Desire or Future Sight. Fails if the user used this move successfully as its last move, disregarding moves used through the Dancer Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 使出招式後，當受到對手攻擊， 陷入瀕死時，對手也會一同陷入瀕死。 連續使用時會失敗。

moves.name: Detect
moves.description: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 完全防住對手的所有攻擊。 連續使用時容易失敗。

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Earthquake and Magnitude but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用後的第１回合潛入地底， 並於第２回合攻擊對手。

moves.name: Dire Claw
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to cause the target to either fall asleep, become poisoned, or become paralyzed.
moves.descriptionZh: 有 30% 的幾率使目標陷入沉睡、中毒或癱瘓。

moves.name: Disable
moves.description: For 4 turns, the target's last move used becomes disabled. Fails if one of the target's moves is already disabled, if the target has not made a move, if the target no longer knows the move, or if the move was a Max or G-Max Move.
moves.descriptionZh: 阻止對手出招， 最近一次使用的招式 在４回合內無法使用。

moves.name: Disarming Voice
moves.description: This move does not check accuracy.
moves.descriptionZh: 發出迷人的叫聲， 給予對手精神上的傷害。 攻擊必定會命中。

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用耀眼的電流 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Dive
moves.description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Surf and Whirlpool but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用後的第１回合潛入水中， 並於第２回合浮上來進行攻擊。

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.description: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 用尾巴等 向對手進行攻擊。 連續２次給予傷害。

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: Raises the user's evasiveness by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 利用快速移動 製造出分身擾亂對手， 提高自己的閃避率。

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
moves.descriptionZh: 捨身衝撞對手進行攻擊。 自己也會受到不小的傷害。

moves.name: Draco Meteor
moves.description: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓隕石從空中落下以攻擊對手。 使用後因為反作用力， 自己的特攻會大幅降低。

moves.name: Dragon Breath
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 將強烈的氣息 吹向對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Dragon Cheer
moves.description: Raises the target's chance for a critical hit by 1 stage, or by 2 stages if the target is Dragon type. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user, or if the target already has this effect or the Focus Energy effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.
moves.descriptionZh: 使目標的暴擊幾率提高1級，如果目標是龍系則提高2級。如果使用者附近沒有盟友，或者目標已經具有此效果或聚焦能量效果，則失敗。接力棒通行證可用於將此效果轉移給盟友。

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 無額外效果。

moves.name: Dragon Dance
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 激烈地跳起神秘又強而有力的舞蹈。 提高自己的攻擊和速度。

moves.name: Dragon Darts
moves.description: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. In Double Battles, this move attempts to hit the targeted Pokemon and its ally once each. If hitting one of these Pokemon would be prevented by immunity, protection, semi-invulnerability, an Ability, or accuracy, it attempts to hit the other Pokemon twice instead. If this move is redirected, it hits that target twice.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓多龍梅西亞進行２次攻擊。 當對手場上有２隻寶可夢時， 則向牠們各進行１次攻擊。

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 從張大的口中 發射衝擊波攻擊對手。

moves.name: Dragon Rush
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
moves.descriptionZh: 釋放出駭人的殺氣， 威嚇並撞擊對手。 有時會使對手畏縮。

moves.name: Dragon Tail
moves.description: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target used Ingrain previously, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.
moves.descriptionZh: 彈飛對手， 強制讓後備寶可夢上場。 對手為野生寶可夢時，戰鬥將直接結束。

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
moves.descriptionZh: 從拳頭吸取對手的力量。 可以回復給予對手 傷害的一半ＨＰ。

moves.name: Draining Kiss
moves.description: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
moves.descriptionZh: 親吻對手來吸取對手的ＨＰ。 可以回復給予對手 傷害的一半以上的ＨＰ。

moves.name: Drill Peck
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 一邊旋轉，一邊將尖喙 刺進對手進行攻擊。

moves.name: Drill Run
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 像鑽頭一樣旋轉身體， 猛烈地撞擊對手。 容易擊中要害。

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.description: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 用翅膀撞向對手進行攻擊。 連續２次給予傷害。

moves.name: Dynamic Punch
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 使出渾身力量出拳進行攻擊。 必定會使對手混亂。

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手腳下 釋放出大地之力。 有時會降低對手的特防。

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: Damage doubles if the target is using Dig.
moves.descriptionZh: 用地震的衝擊， 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。

moves.name: Echoed Voice
moves.description: For every consecutive turn that this move is used by at least one Pokemon, this move's power is multiplied by the number of turns to pass, but not more than 5.
moves.descriptionZh: 用回聲攻擊對手。 每回合有寶可夢持續使用回聲時， 招式的威力會提高。

moves.name: Eerie Impulse
moves.description: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 從身體發出怪異電波 影響對手， 大幅降低對手的特攻。

moves.name: Eerie Spell
moves.description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the target loses 3 PP from its last move.
moves.descriptionZh: 用強大的精神力量攻擊。 讓對手最近一次使用的招式 減少３ＰＰ。

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.description: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Electric Terrain. During the effect, the power of Electric-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot fall asleep; Pokemon already asleep do not wake up. Grounded Pokemon cannot become affected by Yawn or fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into an Electric type, Nature Power becomes Thunderbolt, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause paralysis. Fails if the current terrain is Electric Terrain.
moves.descriptionZh: 在５回合內將腳下變成電氣場地。 地面上的寶可夢將不會陷入睡眠狀態。 電屬性招式的威力會提高。

moves.name: Electrify
moves.description: Causes the target's move to become Electric type this turn. Among effects that can change a move's type, this effect happens last. Fails if the target already moved this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果在對手使用招式前輸電， 該回合對手的招式會變成電屬性。

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.description: The power of this move depends on (user's current Speed / target's current Speed), rounded down. Power is equal to 150 if the result is 4 or more, 120 if 3, 80 if 2, 60 if 1, 40 if less than 1. If the target's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 40.
moves.descriptionZh: 用電球攻擊對手。 速度比對手快越多， 威力越大。

moves.name: Electro Shot
moves.description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Special Attack by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, the move still requires a turn to charge.
moves.descriptionZh: 該攻擊在第一回合衝鋒並在第二回合執行。第一回合使自身特攻提升1級。若持有強力藥草或天氣為元海或雨舞，則一回合內完成招式。若使用者持有實用傘且天氣為原始海或雨舞，該招式仍需回合蓄力。

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 用電網捉住對手進行攻擊。 可降低對手的速度。

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.
moves.descriptionZh: 在接下來的 3 個回合中，目標被迫重複上次使用的動作。如果受影響的動作耗盡PP，效果就會結束。如果目標已經處於此效果之下，如果目標尚未做出動作，如果動作的PP為0，或者如果動作是協助，熾熱扭矩，戰鬥扭矩，模仿者，巨力砲，再演，魔法扭矩，我第一，節拍器，模仿，鏡像移動，自然力量，有毒扭矩，素描，夢話，掙扎，變形或邪惡扭矩，則失敗。

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: Deals damage to the target equal to (target's current HP - user's current HP). The target is unaffected if its current HP is less than or equal to the user's current HP.
moves.descriptionZh: 給予傷害， 使對手的ＨＰ變得 和自己的ＨＰ一樣。

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user will survive attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn with at least 1 HP. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 即使受到再強烈的攻擊， 也一定會剩下１ＨＰ。 連續使用時容易失敗。

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 發射從大自然匯聚而來的生命力量。 有時會降低對手的特防。

moves.name: Entrainment
moves.description: Causes the target's Ability to become the same as the user's. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, or the same Ability as the user, or if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
moves.descriptionZh: 用神奇的節奏跳舞。 讓對手模仿自己的動作， 變成和自己一樣的特性。

moves.name: Eruption
moves.description: Power is equal to (user's current HP * 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.
moves.descriptionZh: 爆發怒火攻擊對手。 自己的ＨＰ越少， 招式的威力越小。

moves.name: Expanding Force
moves.description: If the current terrain is Psychic Terrain and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power multiplied by 1.5.
moves.descriptionZh: 用精神力量攻擊對手。 在精神場地時，威力會提高， 能給予所有對手傷害。

moves.name: Explosion
moves.description: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 引起大爆炸， 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。 使用後自己會陷入瀕死。

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 發送看不見的 神奇力量進行攻擊。 有時會使對手畏縮。

moves.name: Extreme Speed
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 以迅雷不及掩耳之勢 猛撞向對手進行攻擊。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: Power doubles if the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned. The physical damage halving effect from the user's burn is ignored.
moves.descriptionZh: 當自己陷入中毒、麻痺、灼傷等 狀態時，向對手使用此招式， 威力會變成２倍。

moves.name: Fairy Lock
moves.description: Prevents all active Pokemon from switching next turn. A Pokemon can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the effect is already active.
moves.descriptionZh: 封鎖對戰場地， 下一回合所有的 寶可夢都無法逃走。

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. This move cannot be selected unless it is the user's first turn on the field.
moves.descriptionZh: 有100%的幾率使目標退縮。除非是使用者第一次上場，否則無法選擇此動作。

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.description: Lowers the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 裝哭掉眼淚。 讓對手不知所措， 大幅降低對手的特防。

moves.name: False Swipe
moves.description: Leaves the target with at least 1 HP.
moves.descriptionZh: 手下留情地攻擊對手， 一定會讓對手剩下１ＨＰ。

moves.name: Feather Dance
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 撒出羽毛， 纏住對手的身體。 大幅降低對手的攻擊。

moves.name: Feint
moves.description: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.
moves.descriptionZh: 能夠攻擊使用了 守住或看穿的對手。 並解除對手的防守效果。

moves.name: Fell Stinger
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack by 3 stages if this move knocks out the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用此招式打倒對手時， 自己的攻擊會極大幅提高。

moves.name: Fickle Beam
moves.description: Has a 30% chance this move's power is doubled.
moves.descriptionZh: 該招式有 30% 的幾率使威力翻倍。

moves.name: Fiery Dance
moves.description: Has a 50% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓火焰圍繞全身後， 振翅攻擊對手。 有時會提高自己的特攻。

moves.name: Final Gambit
moves.description: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's current HP. If this move is successful, the user faints.
moves.descriptionZh: 捨身攻擊對手。 雖然自己會陷入瀕死，但能夠給予對手 和自己現有ＨＰ相同的傷害。

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用大字形狀的火焰燒盡對手。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

moves.name: Fire Fang
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 用纏繞火焰的牙齒咬住對手。 有時會讓對手畏縮 或陷入灼傷狀態。

moves.name: Fire Lash
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 100%機率使目標防禦降低1級。

moves.name: Fire Pledge
moves.description: If one of the user's allies chose to use Grass Pledge or Water Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Grass Pledge, the ally uses Fire Pledge with 150 power and a sea of fire appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which causes damage to non-Fire types equal to 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn. If combined with Water Pledge, the ally uses Water Pledge with 150 power and a rainbow appears on the user's side for 4 turns, which doubles secondary effect chances and stacks with the Serene Grace Ability, except effects that cause flinching can only have their chance doubled once. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Fire Gem.
moves.descriptionZh: 用火柱進行攻擊。 和草之誓約同時使用時，威力會提高， 周圍會變成火海。

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用帶有火焰的拳頭 攻擊對手。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

moves.name: Fire Spin
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
moves.descriptionZh: 將對手困在 熊熊燃燒的火焰旋渦中， 在４～５回合內進行攻擊。

moves.name: First Impression
moves.description: This move cannot be selected unless it is the user's first turn on the field.
moves.descriptionZh: 除非是使用者第一次上場，否則無法選擇此動作。

moves.name: Fissure
moves.description: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓對手掉進地面的 裂縫中進行攻擊。 只要命中就會一擊瀕死。

moves.name: Flail
moves.description: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP * 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.
moves.descriptionZh: 抓狂般亂打進行攻擊。 自己的ＨＰ越少， 招式的威力越大。

moves.name: Flame Charge
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓火焰圍繞全身後攻擊對手。 同時蓄積力量來提高自己的速度。

moves.name: Flame Wheel
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用火焰圍繞身體， 猛撞對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發射 強烈火焰進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to burn the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
moves.descriptionZh: 將火焰圍繞全身後猛撞對手。 自己也會受到不小的傷害。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 將身體的光芒 聚集在一個點後釋放出去。 有時會降低對手的特防。

moves.name: Flatter
moves.description: Raises the target's Special Attack by 1 stage and confuses it.
moves.descriptionZh: 吹捧對手，使其混亂。 同時還會提高對手的特攻。

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The power of this move is based on the user's held item. The held item is lost and it activates for the target if applicable. If there is no target or the target avoids this move by protecting itself, the user's held item is still lost. The user can regain a thrown item with Recycle or the Harvest Ability. Fails if the user has no held item, if the held item cannot be thrown, if the user is under the effect of Embargo or Magic Room, or if the user has the Klutz Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 快速投擲攜帶的道具進行攻擊。 招式威力和效果會隨著 道具不同而改變。

moves.name: Flip Turn
moves.description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
moves.descriptionZh: 攻擊後迅速返回， 和後備寶可夢進行替換。

moves.name: Flower Trick
moves.description: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities. This move does not check accuracy.
moves.descriptionZh: 除非目標處於幸運頌歌的效果或具有戰甲或貝殼甲技能，否則此招式始終是致命一擊。此動作不檢查準確性。

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用後的第１回合飛上天空， 並於第２回合攻擊對手。

moves.name: Flying Press
moves.description: This move combines Flying in its type effectiveness against the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
moves.descriptionZh: 從空中俯衝向對手進行攻擊。 此招式同時具有 格鬥屬性和飛行屬性。

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 提高氣勢， 釋放全身所有力量。 有時會降低對手的特防。

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.description: Raises the user's chance for a critical hit by 2 stages. Fails if the user already has the effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.
moves.descriptionZh: 深呼吸後集中精神。 讓自己的攻擊 變得容易擊中要害。

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.description: The user loses its focus and does nothing if it is hit by a damaging attack this turn before it can execute the move.
moves.descriptionZh: 集中精神後出拳。 若出拳前受到攻擊， 則會失敗。

moves.name: Follow Me
moves.description: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.
moves.descriptionZh: 吸引對手的注意， 將對手的攻擊 全部轉移到自己身上。

moves.name: Forest's Curse
moves.description: Causes the Grass type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Grass type. If Trick-or-Treat adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手施加森林詛咒。 中了詛咒的對手 會被追加草屬性。

moves.name: Foul Play
moves.description: Damage is calculated using the target's Attack stat, including stat stage changes. The user's Ability, item, and burn are used as normal.
moves.descriptionZh: 利用對手的力量進行攻擊。 對手的攻擊越高， 給予對手的傷害越大。

moves.name: Freeze-Dry
moves.description: This move's type effectiveness against Water is changed to be super effective no matter what this move's type is.
moves.descriptionZh: 無論該招式的類型是什麼，該招式對水的類型有效性均更改為超級有效。

moves.name: Frenzy Plant
moves.description: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
moves.descriptionZh: 將大大的樹木 甩向對手進行攻擊。 下一回合自己將無法動彈。

moves.name: Frost Breath
moves.description: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.
moves.descriptionZh: 將冰冷的氣息 吹向對手進行攻擊。 必定會擊中要害。

moves.name: Fury Cutter
moves.description: Power doubles with each successful hit, up to a maximum of 160 power. The power is reset if this move misses or another move is used.
moves.descriptionZh: 用鐮刀或爪子等 斬切對手進行攻擊。 連續命中時威力會提高。

moves.name: Fury Swipes
moves.description: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
moves.descriptionZh: 用爪子或鐮刀等 向對手進行攻擊。 可連續攻擊２～５次。

moves.name: Future Sight
moves.description: Deals damage two turns after this move is used. At the end of that turn, the damage is calculated at that time and dealt to the Pokemon at the position the target had when the move was used. If the user is no longer active at the time, damage is calculated based on the user's natural Special Attack stat, types, and level, with no boosts from its held item or Ability. Fails if this move or Doom Desire is already in effect for the target's position.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用招式的２回合後， 向對手發送一團念力進行攻擊。

moves.name: Gastro Acid
moves.description: Causes the target's Ability to be rendered ineffective as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain under this effect. If the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, this move fails, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.
moves.descriptionZh: 將胃液吐向對手的身體。 沾到的胃液會消除 對手的特性效果。

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
moves.descriptionZh: 吸取對手的養分進行攻擊。 可以回復給予對手 傷害的一半ＨＰ。

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
moves.descriptionZh: 使出全身上下所有力量突擊對手。 下一回合自己將無法動彈。

moves.name: Gigaton Hammer
moves.description: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用後回合無法選擇。

moves.name: Glare
moves.description: Paralyzes the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用腹部的花紋使對手心生恐懼， 讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.
moves.descriptionZh: 用打結的草絆倒對手。 對手越重，威力越大。

moves.name: Grassy Glide
moves.description: If the current terrain is Grassy Terrain and the user is grounded, this move has its priority increased by 1.
moves.descriptionZh: 在地面上滑行般地攻擊對手。 在青草場地時， 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

moves.name: Grassy Terrain
moves.description: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Grassy Terrain. During the effect, the power of Grass-type attacks used by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3, the power of Bulldoze, Earthquake, and Magnitude used against grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 0.5, and grounded Pokemon have 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn, including the last turn. Camouflage transforms the user into a Grass type, Nature Power becomes Energy Ball, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause sleep. Fails if the current terrain is Grassy Terrain.
moves.descriptionZh: 在５回合內將腳下變成青草場地。 地面上的寶可夢每回合都會回復ＨＰ。 草屬性招式的威力會提高。

moves.name: Grav Apple
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage. Power is multiplied by 1.5 during Gravity's effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 100%機率使目標防禦降低1級。在重力作用期間，力量會乘以 1.5。

moves.name: Gravity
moves.description: For 5 turns, the evasiveness of all active Pokemon is multiplied by 0.6. At the time of use, Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, and Telekinesis end immediately for all active Pokemon. During the effect, Bounce, Fly, Flying Press, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, Splash, and Telekinesis are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. Ground-type attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability can affect Flying types or Pokemon with the Levitate Ability. Fails if this move is already in effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 在５回合內，飄浮特性和飛行屬性的 寶可夢會被地面屬性的招式擊中。 且無法使用飛向空中的招式。

moves.name: Growth
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If the weather is Sunny Day or Desolate Land, this move raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella, this move will only raise the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage, even if the weather is Sunny Day or Desolate Land.
moves.descriptionZh: 使自身的攻擊力和特攻力提升1級。若天氣是晴天或荒地，該招式使使用者的攻擊力和特攻力提升2級。若使用者持有實用傘，該招式只會使使用者的攻擊力和特攻力提升1級，即使天氣是晴天或荒地。

moves.name: Guard Split
moves.description: The user and the target have their Defense and Special Defense stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Defense and Special Defense stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.
moves.descriptionZh: 用超能力將自己和對手的 防禦和特防各別相加後， 再進行平分。

moves.name: Guard Swap
moves.description: The user swaps its Defense and Special Defense stat stage changes with the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用超能力將自己和對手的 防禦與特防的能力變化互相交換。

moves.name: Guillotine
moves.description: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
moves.descriptionZh: 用巨大的鉗子或剪刀等 撕裂對手進行攻擊。 只要命中就會一擊瀕死。

moves.name: Gunk Shot
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 將骯髒的垃圾 丟向對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.description: Power is equal to (25 * target's current Speed / user's current Speed) + 1, rounded down, but not more than 150. If the user's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 1.
moves.descriptionZh: 高速旋轉身體，撞擊對手。 速度比對手越慢，威力越大。

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Hail. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are an Ice type or have the Ice Body, Magic Guard, Overcoat, or Snow Cloak Abilities. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Hail.
moves.descriptionZh: 降下冰雹，在５回合內 場上除了冰屬性以外的寶可夢 都會受到傷害。

moves.name: Hammer Arm
moves.description: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 揮出強力而沉重的拳頭， 給予對手傷害。 自己的速度會降低。

moves.name: Hard Press
moves.description: Power is equal to 100 * (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.
moves.descriptionZh: 力量等於100*（目標目前生命值/目標最大生命值），四捨五入，但不小於1。

moves.name: Harden
moves.description: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用全身的力量讓身體硬化， 提高自己的防禦。

moves.name: Haze
moves.description: Resets the stat stages of all active Pokemon to 0.
moves.descriptionZh: 放出黑霧，讓場上全體寶可夢的 能力變化回到初始狀態。

moves.name: Head Smash
moves.description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
moves.descriptionZh: 使出渾身力量， 捨身向對手進行頭錘攻擊。 自己也會受到非常大的傷害。

moves.name: Headlong Rush
moves.description: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 使自身防禦、特防降低1級。

moves.name: Heal Bell
moves.description: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition. Active Pokemon with the Soundproof Ability are not cured, unless they are the user.
moves.descriptionZh: 發出悅耳的鈴聲， 治癒我方全體的異常狀態。

moves.name: Heal Pulse
moves.description: The target restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user has the Mega Launcher Ability, the target instead restores 3/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.
moves.descriptionZh: 釋放出治癒波動， 讓對手回復 最大ＨＰ的一半。

moves.name: Healing Wish
moves.description: The user faints, and if the Pokemon brought out to replace it does not have full HP or has a non-volatile status condition, its HP is fully restored along with having any non-volatile status condition cured. The replacement is sent out at the end of the turn, and the healing happens before hazards take effect. This effect continues until a Pokemon that meets either of these conditions switches in at the user's position or gets swapped into the position with Ally Switch. Fails if the user is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party.
moves.descriptionZh: 雖然自己會陷入瀕死， 但可以治癒接替上場的 寶可夢的異常狀態並回復ＨＰ。

moves.name: Heat Crash
moves.description: The power of this move depends on (user's weight / target's weight), rounded down. Power is equal to 120 if the result is 5 or more, 100 if 4, 80 if 3, 60 if 2, and 40 if 1 or less. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
moves.descriptionZh: 用燃燒的身體重壓對手 進行攻擊。體重比對手 重越多，威力越大。

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 將炎熱的氣息 吹向對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

moves.name: Heavy Slam
moves.description: The power of this move depends on (user's weight / target's weight), rounded down. Power is equal to 120 if the result is 5 or more, 100 if 4, 80 if 3, 60 if 2, and 40 if 1 or less. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
moves.descriptionZh: 用沉重的身體衝撞對手進行攻擊。 體重比對手重越多，威力越大。

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.
moves.descriptionZh: 幫助夥伴。 被幫助的寶可夢， 招式的威力會比原來更大。

moves.name: Hex
moves.description: Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.
moves.descriptionZh: 接二連三地向對手進行攻擊。 攻擊陷入異常狀態的對手時， 能給予較大的傷害。

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 使出全身力量， 猛攻對手。

moves.name: High Jump Kick
moves.description: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.
moves.descriptionZh: 跳起後用膝蓋踢擊對手。 沒踢中對手時自己會受到傷害。

moves.name: Hone Claws
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack and accuracy by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 將爪子磨得更加鋒利。 可提高自己的攻擊和命中率。

moves.name: Horn Drill
moves.description: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
moves.descriptionZh: 用旋轉的角 刺進對手進行攻擊。 只要命中就會一擊瀕死。

moves.name: Horn Leech
moves.description: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
moves.descriptionZh: 將角刺進對手，吸取養分。 可以回復給予對手 傷害的一半ＨＰ。

moves.name: Howl
moves.description: Raises the Attack of the user and all allies 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 自身及所有盟友的攻擊力提升1級。

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.
moves.descriptionZh: 用強烈的風席捲 對手進行攻擊。 有時會使對手混亂。

moves.name: Hydro Cannon
moves.description: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發射水炮進行攻擊。 下一回合自己將無法動彈。

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手猛烈地噴射 大量水流進行攻擊。

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發射 強烈的光線進行攻擊。 下一回合自己將無法動彈。

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 製造出震耳欲聾的 巨大聲波攻擊對手。

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: Causes the target to fall asleep.
moves.descriptionZh: 施加引發睡意的暗示， 讓對手陷入睡眠狀態。

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發射 冰凍光束進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入冰凍狀態。

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 用帶有寒氣的牙齒咬住對手。 有時會讓對手畏縮 或陷入冰凍狀態。

moves.name: Ice Hammer
moves.description: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 揮出強力而沉重的拳頭， 給予對手傷害。 自己的速度會降低。

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用帶有寒氣的拳頭 攻擊對手。 有時會讓對手陷入冰凍狀態。

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 將瞬間製造出的冰塊 快速地扔向對手。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

moves.name: Ice Spinner
moves.description: Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.
moves.descriptionZh: 結束電力地形、草地地形、迷霧地形和心靈地形的效果。

moves.name: Icicle Crash
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 將巨大冰柱猛烈地 砸向對手進行攻擊。 有時會使對手畏縮。

moves.name: Icicle Spear
moves.description: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發射 尖銳的冰柱進行攻擊。 可連續攻擊２～５次。

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 將冰冷的寒氣 吹向對手進行攻擊。 可降低對手的速度。

moves.name: Imprison
moves.description: The user prevents all opposing Pokemon from using any moves that the user also knows as long as the user remains active.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果對手也學會了和自己 相同的招式，則對手將 不能使用該招式。

moves.name: Infernal Parade
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.
moves.descriptionZh: 有30%的幾率燃燒目標。如果目標具有非揮發性狀態條件，則功率加倍。

moves.name: Inferno
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to burn the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用猛烈的火焰 包圍對手進行攻擊。 能讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

moves.name: Infestation
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
moves.descriptionZh: 在４～５回合內 死纏爛打地進行攻擊。 在此期間對手將無法逃走。

moves.name: Ingrain
moves.description: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP restored at the end of each turn, but it is prevented from switching out and other Pokemon cannot force the user to switch out. The user can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the user leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped and still receive the healing effect. During the effect, the user can be hit normally by Ground-type attacks and be affected by Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web, even if the user is a Flying type or has the Levitate Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 在大地上扎根， 每回合會回復自己的ＨＰ。 但扎根之後無法進行替換。

moves.name: Instruct
moves.description: The target immediately uses its last used move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, if the target is preparing to use Beak Blast, Focus Punch, or Shell Trap, or if the move is Assist, Beak Blast, Belch, Bide, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Focus Punch, Hold Hands, Ice Ball, Instruct, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Obstruct, Outrage, Petal Dance, Rollout, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Thrash, Transform, Uproar, Wicked Torque, any two-turn move, or any recharge move.
moves.descriptionZh: 對手使出招式之後， 能夠透過指令讓對手 再次使出相同招式。

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 將皮膚變得堅硬如鐵， 大幅提高自己的防禦。

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 有20%的幾率使目標退縮。

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 將堅硬的尾巴 甩向對手進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的防禦。

moves.name: Jet Punch
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 無額外效果。

moves.name: King's Shield
moves.description: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user have their Attack lowered by 1 stage. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 在本回合中，用戶可以免受其他神奇寶貝的大多數攻擊，並且嘗試與用戶接觸的神奇寶貝的攻擊力會降低1級。非破壞性動作會受到這種保護。此動作有 1/X 的成功機會，其中 X 從 1 開始，每次成功使用此動作時 X 會增加三倍。如果此動作失敗，如果使用者使用的最後一個動作不是「Baneful Bunker」、「Burning Bulwark」、「Detect」、「Endure」、「King's Shield」、「Max Guard」、「Obstruct」、「Protect」、「Quick Guard」、「Silk Trap」、「Obstruct」、「Protect」、「Quick Guard」、「Sikylk Trap」、「Spiky Guard」或「Spiky Guard」，如果這些動作是「Spiky」，如果這些動作是「Spiky」，如果這些動作是「Spiky Guard」。如果用戶本回合最後移動則失敗。

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.description: This move's power is multiplied by 1.5 if the target is holding an item, and the target loses its held item. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. This move does not increase in power or remove the target's item if it is a Mega Stone held by the species that can Mega Evolve with it. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 拍落對手的持有物， 讓對手在戰鬥結束前都無法使用。 對手有攜帶物品時，傷害會增加。

moves.name: Kowtow Cleave
moves.description: This move does not check accuracy.
moves.descriptionZh: 此動作不檢查準確性。

moves.name: Lash Out
moves.description: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 將惱怒砸向對手進行攻擊。 如果此回合已被降低能力， 招式威力就會變成２倍。

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.description: This move fails unless the user knows this move and at least one other move, and has used all the other moves it knows at least once each since it became active or Transformed.
moves.descriptionZh: 在戰鬥中將其他已學會的招式 全部使用過後， 才能夠使出的珍藏招式。

moves.name: Last Respects
moves.description: Power is equal to 50+(X*50), where X is the total number of times any Pokemon has fainted on the user's side, and X cannot be greater than 100.
moves.descriptionZh: 力量等於50+(X*50)，其中X是用戶一方任何神奇寶貝暈倒的總次數，且X不能大於100。

moves.name: Lava Plume
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to burn the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用熊熊烈火 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

moves.name: Leaf Blade
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 如用劍般操控葉子 切斬對手進行攻擊。 容易擊中要害。

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.description: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 用尖銳的葉子捲起風暴向對手進行攻擊。 使用後因為反作用力， 自己的特攻會大幅降低。

moves.name: Leech Life
moves.description: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
moves.descriptionZh: 吸取對手的血液進行攻擊。 可以回復給予對手 傷害的一半ＨＰ。

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.description: The Pokemon at the user's position steals 1/8 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. If Big Root is held by the recipient, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue being leeched. If the target switches out or uses Mortal Spin or Rapid Spin successfully, the effect ends. Grass-type Pokemon are immune to this move on use, but not its effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 在對手身上植入種子， 每回合吸取對手少許的ＨＰ， 用來回復自己的ＨＰ。

moves.name: Lick
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用長長的舌頭， 舔遍對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Life Dew
moves.description: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
moves.descriptionZh: 灑出神奇之水， 回復自己和場上同伴的ＨＰ。

moves.name: Light of Ruin
moves.description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
moves.descriptionZh: 借用永恆之花的力量， 發射出強力光線。 自己也會受到不小的傷害。

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
moves.descriptionZh: 利用神奇的屏障， 在５回合內減輕 來自對手的特殊攻擊傷害。

moves.name: Liquidation
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 用水之力量撞向對手進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的防禦。

moves.name: Lock-On
moves.description: Until the end of the next turn, the target cannot avoid the user's moves, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field. Fails if this effect is active for the user.
moves.descriptionZh: 精確地瞄準， 下次攻擊時一定 會命中對手。

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description: This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.
moves.descriptionZh: 用力踢對手的腳， 讓對手摔倒進行攻擊。 對手越重，威力越大。

moves.name: Low Sweep
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 瞄準對手的腳， 以敏捷的動作進行攻擊。 可降低對手的速度。

moves.name: Lumina Crash
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 100%機率降低目標特防2級。

moves.name: Lunge
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 全力猛撲對手進行攻擊。 進而降低對手的攻擊。

moves.name: Mach Punch
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 以迅雷不及掩耳之勢出拳。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

moves.name: Magic Coat
moves.description: Until the end of the turn, the user is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or the Magic Bounce Ability's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or the Magic Bounce Ability's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this move takes effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 若對手使用寄生種子或 其他會讓寶可夢陷入異常狀態的招式時， 可將對手的招式反彈回去。

moves.name: Magic Powder
moves.description: Causes the target to become a Psychic type. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Psychic type, or if the target is Terastallized.
moves.descriptionZh: 撒出魔法粉末， 使對手變為超能力屬性。

moves.name: Magic Room
moves.description: For 5 turns, the held items of all active Pokemon have no effect. An item's effect of causing forme changes is unaffected, but any other effects from such items are negated. During the effect, Fling and Natural Gift are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
moves.descriptionZh: 創造出非常不可思議的空間。 在５回合內，所有寶可夢 攜帶的道具都會失去效果。

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.description: This move does not check accuracy.
moves.descriptionZh: 散落可以追蹤 對手的神奇葉子。 攻擊必定會命中。

moves.name: Magnet Rise
moves.description: For 5 turns, the user is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will gain the effect. Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball override this move if the user is under any of their effects. Fails if the user is already under this effect or the effects of Ingrain, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.
moves.descriptionZh: 利用電氣產生的磁力浮在空中。 在５回合內可以飄浮。

moves.name: Magnetic Flux
moves.description: Raises the Defense and Special Defense of Pokemon on the user's side with the Plus or Minus Abilities by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 操控磁場， 提高特性是正電和負電的 寶可夢的防禦和特防。

moves.name: Make It Rain
moves.description: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 使使用者的特攻降低2級。

moves.name: Matcha Gotcha
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to burn the target. The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. The target thaws out if it is frozen.
moves.descriptionZh: 有20%的幾率燃燒目標。用戶恢復目標損失HP的1/2，四捨五入到一半。若使用者持有大根，HP恢復量為正常的1.3倍，四捨五入一半。如果目標被凍結，它就會解凍。

moves.name: Mean Look
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
moves.descriptionZh: 用漆黑深邃的眼神 一動也不動地凝視對手， 讓對手無法從戰鬥中逃走。

moves.name: Mega Kick
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 用灌注了巨大力量的重踢 踢飛對手進行攻擊。

moves.name: Mega Punch
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 用帶有強大力量的拳頭 攻擊對手。

moves.name: Megahorn
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 用堅硬且華麗的角狠狠地 刺進對手進行攻擊。

moves.name: Memento
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. The user faints unless this move misses or there is no target. Fails entirely if this move hits a substitute, but does not fail if the target's stats cannot be changed.
moves.descriptionZh: 雖然自己會陷入瀕死， 但可以大幅降低 對手的攻擊和特攻。

moves.name: Metal Burst
moves.description: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 將發動攻擊前 最後受到的招式傷害放大， 向對手進行反擊。

moves.name: Metal Claw
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 有10%的幾率使自身攻擊力提升1級。

moves.name: Metal Sound
moves.description: Lowers the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓對手聽如同金屬摩擦般 的刺耳聲。 大幅降低對手的特防。

moves.name: Meteor Beam
moves.description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Special Attack by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用後的第１回合會聚集 宇宙的力量來提高特攻， 並於第２回合攻擊對手。

moves.name: Meteor Mash
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 使出如同彗星般的拳頭攻擊對手。 有時會提高自己的攻擊。

moves.name: Minimize
moves.description: Raises the user's evasiveness by 2 stages. Whether or not the user's evasiveness was changed, Body Slam, Dragon Rush, Flying Press, Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Malicious Moonsault, Steamroller, Stomp, and Supercell Slam will not check accuracy and have their damage doubled if used against the user while it is active.
moves.descriptionZh: 蜷縮身體使自己顯得很小， 大幅提高 自己的閃避率。

moves.name: Mirror Coat
moves.description: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a special attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead.
