If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's special attack this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 將來自對手的特殊攻擊傷害加倍後， 返還給該對手。

moves.name: Mist
moves.description: For 5 turns, the user and its party members are protected from having their stat stages lowered by other Pokemon. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
moves.descriptionZh: 用白霧覆蓋身體。 在５回合內不會讓對手 降低自己的能力。

moves.name: Misty Explosion
moves.description: If the current terrain is Misty Terrain and the user is grounded, this move's power is multiplied by 1.5. The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 對自己周圍的所有寶可夢進行攻擊， 但使出後，自己會陷入瀕死。 在薄霧場地時，招式威力會提高。

moves.name: Misty Terrain
moves.description: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Misty Terrain. During the effect, the power of Dragon-type attacks used against grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 0.5 and grounded Pokemon cannot be inflicted with a non-volatile status condition nor confusion. Grounded Pokemon can become affected by Yawn but cannot fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into a Fairy type, Nature Power becomes Moonblast, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower Special Attack by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Misty Terrain.
moves.descriptionZh: 在５回合內， 地面上的寶可夢不會陷入異常狀態。 龍屬性招式的傷害也會減半。

moves.name: Moonblast
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 有10%機率使目標特攻降低1級。

moves.name: Moonlight
moves.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Delta Stream or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.
moves.descriptionZh: 回復自己的ＨＰ。 回復量會隨著天氣的不同 而有所變化。

moves.name: Morning Sun
moves.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Delta Stream or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.
moves.descriptionZh: 回復自己的ＨＰ。 回復量會隨著天氣的不同 而有所變化。

moves.name: Mortal Spin
moves.description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field. Has a 100% chance to poison the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果此動作成功且使用者沒有暈倒，則水蛭種子和束縛動作的效果對使用者結束，並且所有危險都會從使用者這邊的場地中移除。有100%的幾率使目標中毒。

moves.name: Mountain Gale
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 有30%的幾率使目標退縮。

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手投擲 泥塊進行攻擊。 同時降低對手的速度。

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手的臉等處 投擲泥巴進行攻擊。 可降低對手的命中率。

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 用渾濁的污水攻擊對手。 有時會降低對手的命中率。

moves.name: Mystical Fire
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 從口中吐出特別灼熱的 火焰進行攻擊。 可降低對手的特攻。

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description: Raises the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 動歪腦筋，活化大腦。 大幅提高自己的特攻。

moves.name: Night Daze
moves.description: Has a 40% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 有40%的幾率使目標精準度降低1級。

moves.name: Night Shade
moves.description: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's level.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓對手看見恐怖幻影， 給予對手和自己等級 相同的傷害。

moves.name: Night Slash
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 造成暴擊的幾率更高。

moves.name: No Retreat
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage, but it becomes prevented from switching out. The user can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the user has already been prevented from switching by this effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 提高自己所有的能力， 但無法進行替換或逃走。

moves.name: Noble Roar
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 發出戰吼威嚇對手， 降低對手的 攻擊和特攻。

moves.name: Nuzzle
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用帶電的臉頰 磨蹭對手進行攻擊。 能讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Outrage
moves.description: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
moves.descriptionZh: 在２～３回合內 瘋狂亂打對手進行攻擊。 大鬧一番後自己會陷入混亂。

moves.name: Overheat
moves.description: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 釋放全部能量攻擊對手。 使用後因為反作用力， 自己的特攻會大幅降低。

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.description: The user and the target's HP become the average of their current HP, rounded down, but not more than the maximum HP of either one.
moves.descriptionZh: 將自己的ＨＰ和 對手的ＨＰ相加， 然後雙方友好地平分。

moves.name: Parabolic Charge
moves.description: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
moves.descriptionZh: 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。 可以回復給予傷害的一半ＨＰ。

moves.name: Parting Shot
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If this move is successful, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if the target's Attack and Special Attack stat stages were both unchanged, or if there are no unfainted party members.
moves.descriptionZh: 拋下狠話恐嚇對手， 降低對手的攻擊和特攻後， 和後備寶可夢進行替換。

moves.name: Payback
moves.description: Power doubles if the user moves after the target this turn, including actions taken through Instruct or the Dancer Ability. Switching in does not count as an action.
moves.descriptionZh: 累積力量進行攻擊。 若在對手之後進行攻擊， 招式的威力會變成２倍。

moves.name: Perish Song
moves.description: Each active Pokemon receives a perish count of 4 if it doesn't already have a perish count. At the end of each turn including the turn used, the perish count of all active Pokemon lowers by 1 and Pokemon faint if the number reaches 0. The perish count is removed from Pokemon that switch out. If a Pokemon uses Baton Pass while it has a perish count, the replacement will gain the perish count and continue to count down.
moves.descriptionZh: 聽了歌聲的寶可夢 ３回合後將陷入瀕死。 替換寶可夢後效果就會消失。

moves.name: Petal Blizzard
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 猛烈地刮起飛雪般的落花， 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。

moves.name: Petal Dance
moves.description: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
moves.descriptionZh: 在２～３回合內 不斷灑出花瓣攻擊對手。 招式結束後自己會陷入混亂狀態。

moves.name: Phantom Force
moves.description: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用後的第１回合消失到某處， 並於第２回合攻擊對手。 可不顧對手的守護進行攻擊。

moves.name: Pin Missile
moves.description: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發射 銳利的針進行攻擊。 可連續攻擊２～５次。

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 在和對手嬉鬧的同時進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的攻擊。

moves.name: Pluck
moves.description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 用鳥喙進行攻擊。 可以吃下對手攜帶的樹果， 並獲得樹果的效果。

moves.name: Poison Fang
moves.description: Has a 50% chance to badly poison the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用有毒的牙齒 咬住對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入劇毒狀態。

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 以帶有毒性的觸手或手臂刺進對手。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.description: Poisons the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 撒出大量的有毒粉末 讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

moves.name: Poison Tail
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to poison the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 將尾巴甩向對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態， 且容易擊中要害。

moves.name: Pollen Puff
moves.description: If the target is an ally, this move restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down, instead of dealing damage.
moves.descriptionZh: 對敵人使用時，用會爆炸的花粉團來攻擊。 對我方同伴使用時， 則給予有回復效果的花粉團。

moves.name: Poltergeist
moves.description: Fails if the target has no held item.
moves.descriptionZh: 操控對手的持有物進行攻擊。 對手沒有攜帶道具時， 則會失敗。

moves.name: Population Bomb
moves.description: Hits ten times. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit ten times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move hits four to ten times at random without checking accuracy between hits.
moves.descriptionZh: 連擊十次。此動作會檢查每次命中的準確性，如果目標避免命中，則攻擊結束。如果其中一擊打壞了目標的替身，則其餘的擊中都會受到傷害。如果使用者擁有技能連動能力，這招總是會命中十次。如果使用者持有已載入的骰子，則此移動會隨機命中四到十次，而不檢查命中之間的準確性。

moves.name: Pounce
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 100%機率使目標速度降低1級。

moves.name: Pound
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用長長的尾巴或手等 拍打對手進行攻擊。

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 發射如寶石般 閃耀的光芒攻擊對手。

moves.name: Power Split
moves.description: The user and the target have their Attack and Special Attack stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Attack and Special Attack stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.
moves.descriptionZh: 用超能力將自己和對手的 攻擊和特攻各別相加後， 再進行平分。

moves.name: Power Swap
moves.description: The user swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat stage changes with the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用超能力將自己和對手的 攻擊與特攻的能力變化互相交換。

moves.name: Power Trick
moves.description: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats, and stat stage changes remain on their respective stats. This move can be used again to swap the stats back. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.
moves.descriptionZh: 利用超能力， 將自己的攻擊和 防禦互相交換。

moves.name: Power Trip
moves.description: Power is equal to 20+(X*20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.
moves.descriptionZh: 耀武揚威地攻擊對手， 自己的能力提高得越多， 威力就越大。

moves.name: Power Whip
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 激烈地揮舞藤蔓或觸手 向對手進行攻擊。

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 在本回合中，用戶可以免受其他神奇寶貝發起的大多數攻擊。此動作有 1/X 的成功機會，其中 X 從 1 開始，每次成功使用此動作時 X 會增加三倍。如果此動作失敗，如果使用者使用的最後一個動作不是「Baneful Bunker」、「Burning Bulwark」、「Detect」、「Endure」、「King's Shield」、「Max Guard」、「Obstruct」、「Protect」、「Quick Guard」、「Silk Trap」、「Obstruct」、「Protect」、「Quick Guard」、「Sikylk Trap」、「Spiky Guard」或「Spiky Guard」，如果這些動作是「Spiky」，如果這些動作是「Spiky」，如果這些動作是「Spiky Guard」。如果用戶本回合最後移動則失敗。

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發射 神奇的光線進行攻擊。 有時會使對手混亂。

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user copies all of the target's current stat stage changes.
moves.descriptionZh: 向自己施加自我暗示， 讓能力變化的狀態 變得與對手相同。

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發送 強大的念力進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的特防。

moves.name: Psychic Fangs
moves.description: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.
moves.descriptionZh: 利用精神力量咬住對手進行攻擊。 並可破壞光牆和反射壁等。

moves.name: Psychic Noise
moves.description: For 2 turns, the target is prevented from restoring any HP as long as it remains active. During the effect, healing and draining moves are unusable, and Abilities and items that grant healing will not heal the user. If an affected Pokemon uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to restore its HP. Pain Split and the Regenerator Ability are unaffected.
moves.descriptionZh: 2回合內，只要目標保持活動狀態，就無法恢復任何生命值。在此效果期間，治療和吸取技能無法使用，並且提供治療的能力和物品也不會治療使用者。如果受影響的神奇寶貝使用了接力棒通行證，替代品將無法恢復其生命值。疼痛分裂和再生能力不受影響。

moves.name: Psychic Terrain
moves.description: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain. During the effect, the power of Psychic-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot be hit by moves with priority greater than 0, unless the target is an ally. Camouflage transforms the user into a Psychic type, Nature Power becomes Psychic, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Psychic Terrain.
moves.descriptionZh: 在５回合內，地面上的寶可夢 不會受到先制招式攻擊。 超能力屬性的招式威力會提高。

moves.name: Psycho Cut
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 用實體化的 精神利刃斬向對手。 容易擊中要害。

moves.name: Psyshield Bash
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 100%機率使自身防禦提升1級。

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.
moves.descriptionZh: 將神奇的念力波實體化後攻擊對手。 給予對手物理傷害。

moves.name: Quash
moves.description: Causes the target to take its turn after all other Pokemon this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target already moved this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 壓制對手，讓對手在 回合的最後才能行動。

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 以迅雷不及掩耳之勢 撲向對手。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

moves.name: Quick Guard
moves.description: The user and its party members are protected from attacks with original or altered priority greater than 0 made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
moves.descriptionZh: 保護自己和同伴， 防禦來自對手的先制攻擊。

moves.name: Quiver Dance
moves.description: Raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 輕巧地跳起神秘又美麗的舞蹈。 提高自己的特攻、特防和速度。

moves.name: Rage Fist
moves.description: Power is equal to 50+(X*50), where X is the total number of times the user has been hit by a damaging attack during the battle, even if the user did not lose HP from the attack. X cannot be greater than 6 and resets to 0 when the user leaves the field. Each hit of a multi-hit attack is counted, but confusion damage is not counted.
moves.descriptionZh: 力量等於50+(X*50)，其中X是使用者在戰鬥中受到傷害性攻擊的總次數，即使使用者沒有因攻擊而損失生命值。 X 不能大於 6，且當使用者離開該欄位時重設為 0。多重攻擊的每次攻擊都會被計算在內，但混亂傷害不會被計算在內。

moves.name: Rage Powder
moves.description: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.
moves.descriptionZh: 將令人煩躁的粉末撒在自己身上， 吸引對手的注意。進而將對手的攻擊 全部轉移到自己身上。

moves.name: Raging Bull
moves.description: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated. If the user's current form is a Paldean Tauros, this move's type changes to match. Fighting type for Combat Breed, Fire type for Blaze Breed, and Water type for Aqua Breed.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果這次攻擊沒有失手，在計算傷害之前，目標方場上的反射、光幕和極光帷幕的效果就會結束。如果使用者目前的形態是八神金牛座，則此招式的類型會變更以符合。戰鬥品種為戰鬥型，火焰品種為火型，水族品種為水型。

moves.name: Raging Fury
moves.description: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用者花費兩到三回合鎖定該動作，並且在該效果的最後一回合移動後立即感到困惑（如果還沒有的話）。此招式每回合隨機瞄準敵對的神奇寶貝。如果使用者被阻止移動，在回合開始時睡著，或在效果的第一回合或三回合效果的第二回合對目標的攻擊沒有成功，則效果結束而不會造成混亂。如果此招式被夢話呼叫且使用者睡著了，則該招式將使用一回合並且不會迷惑使用者。

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Rain Dance. The damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Damp Rock. Fails if the current weather is Rain Dance.
moves.descriptionZh: 降下大雨，在５回合內 提高水屬性招式的威力。 火屬性招式的威力會降低。

moves.name: Rapid Spin
moves.description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field. Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 藉由旋轉來攻擊對手。 也可以擺脫綁緊、緊束、寄生種子等招式。 自己的速度也會提高。

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 飛射葉子， 切斬對手進行攻擊。 容易擊中要害。

moves.name: Razor Shell
moves.description: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 用鋒利的貝殼斬切 對手進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的防禦。

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓細胞再生， 回復自己最大ＨＰ的一半。

moves.name: Recycle
moves.description: The user regains the item it last used. Fails if the user is holding an item, if the user has not held an item, if the item was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by a Pokemon with the Pickup Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be regained.
moves.descriptionZh: 將在戰鬥中已消耗完的 寶可夢持有物回收後， 回復成可以使用的狀態。

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
moves.descriptionZh: 利用神奇的屏障， 在５回合內減輕 來自對手的物理攻擊傷害。

moves.name: Reflect Type
moves.description: Causes the user's types to become the same as the current types of the target. If the target's current types include typeless and a non-added type, typeless is ignored. If the target's current types include typeless and an added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat, typeless is copied as the Normal type instead. Fails if the user is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the user is Terastallized, or if the target's current type is typeless alone.
moves.descriptionZh: 在自己身上反映出對手的屬性， 讓自己也變成相同的屬性。

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user falls asleep for the next two turns and restores all of its HP, curing itself of any non-volatile status condition in the process. Fails if the user has full HP, is already asleep, or if another effect is preventing sleep.
moves.descriptionZh: 連續睡２回合。 回復自己的全部ＨＰ 以及治癒所有異常狀態。

moves.name: Retaliate
moves.description: Power doubles if one of the user's party members fainted last turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 為倒下的同伴報仇。 前一回合有同伴被打倒時， 招式的威力會提高。

moves.name: Reversal
moves.description: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP * 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.
moves.descriptionZh: 竭盡全力進行攻擊。 自己的ＨＰ越少， 招式的威力越大。

moves.name: Rising Voltage
moves.description: If the current terrain is Electric Terrain and the target is grounded, this move's power is doubled.
moves.descriptionZh: 用從地面升騰的電擊攻擊。 當對手在電氣場地時， 招式威力會變成２倍。

moves.name: Roar
moves.description: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 趕走對手， 強制讓後備寶可夢上場。 對手為野生寶可夢時，戰鬥將直接結束。

moves.name: Rock Blast
moves.description: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發射 堅硬的岩石進行攻擊。 連續攻擊２～５次。

moves.name: Rock Polish
moves.description: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 打磨自己的身體， 減少空氣阻力。 可大幅提高自己的速度。

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 將大岩石 猛烈地砸向對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手畏縮。

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 用拳頭進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的防禦。

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 投擲岩石進行攻擊。 封住對手的行動， 進而降低其速度。

moves.name: Rock Wrecker
moves.description: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發射 巨大的岩石進行攻擊。 下一回合自己將無法動彈。

moves.name: Role Play
moves.description: The user's Ability changes to match the target's Ability. Fails if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
moves.descriptionZh: 扮演成對手， 讓自己的特性 也變得和對手相同。

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: If this move is successful, the user is locked into this move and cannot make another move until it misses, 5 turns have passed, or the attack cannot be used. Power doubles with each successful hit of this move and doubles again if Defense Curl was used previously by the user. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 在５回合內連續滾動攻擊對手。 每擊中一次，威力就會提高。

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user is not Terastallized, until the end of the turn Flying-type users lose their Flying type and pure Flying-type users become Normal type. Does nothing if the user's HP is full.
moves.descriptionZh: 降落到地面，讓身體休息。 回復自己最大ＨＰ的一半。

moves.name: Round
moves.description: If there are other active Pokemon that chose this move for use this turn, those Pokemon take their turn immediately after the user, in Speed order, and this move's power is 120 for each other user.
moves.descriptionZh: 用歌聲攻擊對手。 大家一起輪唱便可以接連使出， 威力也會提高。

moves.name: Sacred Sword
moves.description: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.
moves.descriptionZh: 用長角斬切對手進行攻擊。 可不顧對手的能力變化 給予傷害。

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: For 5 turns, the user and its party members cannot have non-volatile status conditions or confusion inflicted on them by other Pokemon. Pokemon on the user's side cannot become affected by Yawn but can fall asleep from its effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Defog. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
moves.descriptionZh: 在５回合內 被神奇的力量守護， 不會陷入異常狀態。

moves.name: Salt Cure
moves.description: Causes damage to the target equal to 1/16 of its maximum HP (1/8 if the target is Steel or Water type), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.
moves.descriptionZh: 效果期間每回合結束時對目標造成最大生命值 1/16 的傷害（如果目標是鋼系或水系則為 1/8），向下捨去。當目標不再活躍時，效果就會結束。

moves.name: Sand Attack
moves.description: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手的臉上潑沙， 降低對手的命中率。

moves.name: Sand Tomb
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
moves.descriptionZh: 將對手困在 鋪天蓋地的沙暴中， 在４～５回合內進行攻擊。

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sandstorm. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are a Ground, Rock, or Steel type, or have the Magic Guard, Overcoat, Sand Force, Sand Rush, or Sand Veil Abilities. During the effect, the Special Defense of Rock-type Pokemon is multiplied by 1.5 when taking damage from a special attack. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Smooth Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sandstorm.
moves.descriptionZh: 5回合內，天氣變成沙塵暴。除最後一個回合外，在每個回合結束時，所有活躍的神奇寶貝都會損失其最大生命值的 1/16，向下舍入，除非它們是地面、岩石或鋼鐵類型，或者俱有魔法守衛、大衣、沙力、沙沖或沙幕能力。效果期間，岩石系寶可夢受到特殊攻擊傷害時，特防力會乘以1.5。如果使用者持有 Smooth Rock，則持續 8 回合。如果當前天氣是沙塵暴，則失敗。

moves.name: Scald
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手噴射 滾燙的熱水進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

moves.name: Scale Shot
moves.description: Hits two to five times. Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage and raises the user's Speed by 1 stage after the last hit. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
moves.descriptionZh: 射出鱗片進行攻擊。 可連續攻擊２～５次。 速度會提高但防禦會降低。

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 用恐怖的表情瞪著對手， 讓對手害怕， 大幅降低對手的速度。

moves.name: Scorching Sands
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手投灑熾熱的沙子進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: Lowers the target's Defense by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 發出令人不由自主想要 摀起耳朵的刺耳聲， 大幅降低對手的防禦。

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 從上方砸下外殼堅硬的 大種子，攻擊對手。

moves.name: Seismic Toss
moves.description: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's level.
moves.descriptionZh: 利用引力將對手甩飛出去。 給予對手和自己等級相同的傷害。

moves.name: Self-Destruct
moves.description: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 引起爆炸， 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。 使用後自己會陷入瀕死。

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 投擲一團黑影進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的特防。

moves.name: Shadow Claw
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 造成暴擊的幾率更高。

moves.name: Shadow Punch
moves.description: This move does not check accuracy.
moves.descriptionZh: 暗藏在陰影之中出拳。 攻擊必定會命中。

moves.name: Shadow Sneak
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 伸長自己的影子， 從對手的背後進行攻擊。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

moves.name: Shed Tail
moves.description: The user takes 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, and creates a substitute that has 1/4 of the user's maximum HP, rounded down. The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party and the selected Pokemon has the substitute transferred to it. Fails if the user would faint, or if there are no unfainted party members.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用者取其最大HP的1/2（向上捨入），並建立一個具有使用者最大HP（向下捨去）的1/4的替代品。使用者被其隊伍中的另一個神奇寶貝替換，而所選神奇寶貝的替代者被轉移到它。如果使用者暈倒，或沒有沒有暈倒的黨員，則失敗。

moves.name: Sheer Cold
moves.description: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + X)%, where X is 30 if the user is an Ice type and 20 otherwise, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Ice-type Pokemon and Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
moves.descriptionZh: 一擊讓對手陷入瀕死。 冰屬性以外的寶可夢使用時， 會比較不易命中對手。

moves.name: Shell Side Arm
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to poison the target. This move becomes a physical attack that makes contact if the value of ((((2 * the user's level / 5 + 2) * 90 * X) / Y) / 50), where X is the user's Attack stat and Y is the target's Defense stat, is greater than the same value where X is the user's Special Attack stat and Y is the target's Special Defense stat. No stat modifiers other than stat stage changes are considered for this purpose. If the two values are equal, this move chooses a damage category at random.
moves.descriptionZh: 用物理攻擊和特殊攻擊中 能夠給予更大傷害的能力進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

moves.name: Shell Smash
moves.description: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. Raises the user's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 破殼而出。 自己的防禦和特防會降低， 但能大幅提高攻擊、特攻和速度。

moves.name: Shelter
moves.description: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 使使用者的防禦力提升2級。

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.description: This move does not check accuracy.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手迅速放出電流。 攻擊一定會命中。

moves.name: Simple Beam
moves.description: Causes the target's Ability to become Simple. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Simple, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發射謎樣的念力波。 接收了念力波的對手， 特性會變成單純。

moves.name: Sing
moves.description: Causes the target to fall asleep.
moves.descriptionZh: 唱出舒服美妙的歌聲， 讓對手陷入睡眠狀態。

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description: The user swaps its Ability with the target's Ability. Fails if either the user or the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
moves.descriptionZh: 用超能力將自己和 對手的特性互相交換。

moves.name: Skitter Smack
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 從對手背後爬近後進行攻擊。 會降低對手的特攻。

moves.name: Sky Attack
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch and a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 在使用後的下一回合進行攻擊。 有時會使對手畏縮。 且容易擊中要害。

moves.name: Slack Off
moves.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
moves.descriptionZh: 偷懶休息。 回復自己最大ＨＰ的一半。

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.description: Causes the target to fall asleep.
moves.descriptionZh: 撒出大量令人想睡的粉末， 讓對手陷入睡眠狀態。

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: One of the user's known moves, besides this move, is selected for use at random. Fails if the user is not asleep. The selected move does not have PP deducted from it, and can currently have 0 PP. This move cannot select Assist, Beak Blast, Belch, Bide, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Focus Punch, Hold Hands, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Uproar, Wicked Torque, or any two-turn move.
moves.descriptionZh: 從自己已學會的招式中 隨機選出１個使出。 只有在睡眠狀態時可以使用。

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手投擲污泥進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

moves.name: Sludge Wave
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to poison the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用污泥波攻擊 自己周圍所有的寶可夢。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

moves.name: Smack Down
moves.description: This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. During the effect, Magnet Rise fails for the target and Telekinesis fails against the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 向空中的對手投擲石頭或炮彈等物體 進行攻擊。對手會被擊落，掉到地面。

moves.name: Smart Strike
moves.description: This move does not check accuracy.
moves.descriptionZh: 用尖尖的角刺進對手進行攻擊。 攻擊必定會命中。

moves.name: Smog
moves.description: Has a 40% chance to poison the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 將骯髒的濃霧 吹向對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

moves.name: Smokescreen
moves.description: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手噴出煙霧或墨汁等， 降低對手的命中率。

moves.name: Snap Trap
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
moves.descriptionZh: 防止目標在四到五回合內切換（如果使用者持有握爪，則為七回合）。在效果期間每回合結束時對目標造成等於其最大生命值 1/8 的傷害（如果使用者持有束縛帶則為 1/6），向下捨去。如果目標持有棚殼或使用接力棒傳球、翻轉轉身、分身射擊、棚尾、傳送、掉頭或伏特開關，則目標仍然可以切換出去。如果使用者或目標離開場地，或者目標成功使用致命旋轉、快速旋轉或替代，則效果結束。此效果不可疊加，也不能透過使用此或其他綁定動作來重置。

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 沒完沒了地向對手大聲咆哮， 降低對手的特攻。

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the user is not asleep.
moves.descriptionZh: 在自己睡著時， 發出噪音進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手畏縮。

moves.name: Snowscape
moves.description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. During the effect, the Defense of Ice-type Pokemon is multiplied by 1.5 when taking damage from a physical attack. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Snow.
moves.descriptionZh: 持續 5 回合，天氣變為雪。效果期間，冰屬性寶可夢受到物理攻擊傷害時，防禦力會提升1.5倍。如果使用者持有冰冷岩石，則持續 8 回合。如果當前天氣是雪，則失敗。

moves.name: Soak
moves.description: Causes the target to become a Water type. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Water type, or if the target is Terastallized.
moves.descriptionZh: 朝對手灑下大量的水， 讓對手變成水屬性。

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move still requires a turn to charge.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用後的第１回合吸收大量日光， 並於第２回合發射光束進行攻擊。

moves.name: Solar Blade
moves.description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Hail, Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move still requires a turn to charge.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用後的第１回合吸收大量日光， 並於第２回合把力量 注入劍裡進行攻擊。

moves.name: Spark
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用電流圍繞身體， 猛撞對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Sparkling Aria
moves.description: If the user has not fainted, the target is cured of its burn.
moves.descriptionZh: 隨著歌聲放出許多水球。 受此招式攻擊時， 灼傷會被治癒。

moves.name: Speed Swap
moves.description: The user swaps its Speed stat with the target. Stat stage changes are unaffected.
moves.descriptionZh: 將對手和自己的速度 進行互換。

moves.name: Spicy Extract
moves.description: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and lowers its Defense by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 使目標攻擊力提升2級，防禦力降低2級。

moves.name: Spikes
moves.description: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to three times before failing. Opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
moves.descriptionZh: 將撒菱散布在對手的腳下。 讓對手替換出場的寶可夢 受到傷害。

moves.name: Spiky Shield
moves.description: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
moves.descriptionZh: 在此回合中，用戶可以免受其他 寶可夢 的大多數攻擊，並且與用戶接觸的 寶可夢 會損失最大 HP 的 1/8（向下舍入）。此動作有 1/X 的成功機會，其中 X 從 1 開始，每次成功使用此動作時 X 會增加三倍。如果此動作失敗，如果使用者使用的最後一個動作不是「Baneful Bunker」、「Burning Bulwark」、「Detect」、「Endure」、「King's Shield」、「Max Guard」、「Obstruct」、「Protect」、「Quick Guard」、「Silk Trap」、「Obstruct」、「Protect」、「Quick Guard」、「Sikylk Trap」、「Spiky Guard」或「Spiky Guard」，如果這些動作是「Spiky」，如果這些動作是「Spiky」，如果這些動作是「Spiky Guard」。如果用戶本回合最後移動則失敗。

moves.name: Spirit Break
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 用足以讓對手一蹶不振的 氣勢進行攻擊。 可降低對手的特攻。

moves.name: Spirit Shackle
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
moves.descriptionZh: 防止目標切換出去。如果目標持有棚殼或使用接力棒傳球、翻轉轉身、分身射擊、傳送、掉頭或伏特切換，則目標仍然可以切換出去。如果使用者或目標離開場地，效果就會結束。

moves.name: Spit Up
moves.description: Power is equal to 100 times the user's Stockpile count. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. Whether or not this move is successful, the user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.
moves.descriptionZh: 將蓄積的力量 撞向對手進行攻擊。 蓄積得越多，威力越大。

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: Causes the target's last move used to lose 4 PP. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if it no longer knows the move.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手最近一次使用的招式 發出怨念， 讓該招式減少４ＰＰ。

moves.name: Splash
moves.description: No competitive use.
moves.descriptionZh: 不攻擊對手，只是蹦蹦跳跳的， 什麼事也不會發生……

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25x, 0.5x, neutral, 2x, or 4x, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
moves.descriptionZh: 在對手周圍撒下無數飄浮的岩石， 讓對手替換出場的寶可夢受到傷害。

moves.name: Steel Beam
moves.description: Whether or not this move is successful and even if it would cause fainting, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, unless the user has the Magic Guard Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 將從全身匯聚起來的鋼鐵 化為光束激烈地發射出去。 自己也會受到傷害。

moves.name: Steel Roller
moves.description: Fails if there is no terrain active. Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.
moves.descriptionZh: 一邊破壞場地，一邊進行攻擊。 在不是特殊狀態的場地上使用， 招式就會失敗。

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 用堅硬的翅膀撞擊 對手進行攻擊。 有時會提高自己的防禦。

moves.name: Sticky Web
moves.description: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, lowering the Speed by 1 stage of each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
moves.descriptionZh: 在對手周圍撒下黏黏的網， 降低替換出場的對手的速度。

moves.name: Stockpile
moves.description: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's Stockpile count increases by 1. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 3. The user's Stockpile count is reset to 0 when it is no longer active.
moves.descriptionZh: 蓄積力量， 提高自己的防禦和特防。 最多蓄積３次。

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Power doubles if the user's last move on the previous turn, including moves called by other moves or those used through Instruct, Magic Coat, Snatch, or the Dancer or Magic Bounce Abilities, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, or Mind Blown, or if the user was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging or Sky Drop. A move that was blocked by Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.
moves.descriptionZh: 化悔恨為力量進行攻擊。 如果上一回合的招式沒有命中， 威力就會加倍。

moves.name: Stone Axe
moves.description: If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25x, 0.5x, neutral, 2x, or 4x, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果此動作成功，則會在場地的另一側設置一個危險，對每個切換進來的敵方神奇寶貝造成傷害。敵人會根據其對岩石類型的弱點而損失最大生命值的 1/32、1/16、1/8、1/4 或 1/2，向下舍入；分別為 0.25x、0.5x、中性、2x 或 4x。如果任何神奇寶貝使用整理，或者任何對手神奇寶貝成功使用致命旋轉，快速旋轉或除霧，或者被除霧擊中，則可以從對手移除。

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 用尖銳的岩石 刺進對手進行攻擊。 容易擊中要害。

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.description: Power is equal to 20+(X*20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.
moves.descriptionZh: 用蓄積的力量攻擊對手。 自己的能力提高越多， 招式的威力越大。

moves.name: Storm Throw
moves.description: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發動強烈的一擊。 一定會擊中要害。

moves.name: Strength Sap
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage. The user restores its HP equal to the target's Attack stat calculated with its stat stage before this move was used. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. Fails if the target's Attack stat stage is -6.
moves.descriptionZh: 將自己的ＨＰ回復到和 對手的攻擊力相同。 然後降低對手的攻擊。

moves.name: String Shot
moves.description: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 用口中吐出的絲纏繞對手， 大幅降低對手的速度。

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 抵抗對手進行攻擊。 可降低對手的特攻。

moves.name: Stuff Cheeks
moves.description: Fails if the user is not holding a Berry. The user eats its Berry and raises its Defense by 2 stages. This effect is not prevented by the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果使用者沒有持有 Berry，則失敗。使用者吃了莓果，防禦力提升2級。此效果不會被笨手笨腳或不安能力、禁運或魔法室的效果所阻止。

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.description: Paralyzes the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 撒出大量令人麻痺的粉末， 讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user takes 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, and puts it into a substitute to take its place in battle. The substitute is removed once enough damage is inflicted on it, if the user switches out or faints, or if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up. Baton Pass can be used to transfer the substitute to an ally, and the substitute will keep its remaining HP. Until the substitute is broken, it receives damage from all attacks made by other Pokemon and shields the user from status effects and stat stage changes caused by other Pokemon. Sound-based moves and Pokemon with the Infiltrator Ability ignore substitutes. The user still takes normal damage from weather and status effects while behind its substitute. If the substitute breaks during a multi-hit attack, the user will take damage from any remaining hits. If a substitute is created while the user is trapped by a binding move, the binding effect ends immediately. Fails if the user does not have enough HP remaining to create a substitute without fainting, or if it already has a substitute.
moves.descriptionZh: 消耗一些自己的ＨＰ， 製造分身。 分身將成為自己的替身。

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description: Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.
moves.descriptionZh: 可以搶先對手一步進行攻擊。 若對手使用的不是攻擊招式則會失敗。

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sunny Day. The damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Heat Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sunny Day.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓日照增強，在５回合內 提高火屬性招式的威力。 水屬性招式的威力會降低。

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.description: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.
moves.descriptionZh: 用銳利的門牙 猛烈地咬住對手進行攻擊。 對手的ＨＰ將會減半。

moves.name: Supercell Slam
moves.description: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果這次攻擊不成功，使用者會損失最大生命值的一半，向下捨入，作為碰撞傷害。具有魔法守衛能力的神奇寶貝不受碰撞傷害的影響。如果目標在活動時使用了最小化，傷害會加倍，並且不會進行精確度檢查。

moves.name: Superpower
moves.description: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 發揮驚人的力量攻擊對手。 自己的攻擊和防禦會降低。

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: Damage doubles if the target is using Dive.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用大浪 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and confuses it.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓對手火大並陷入混亂。 但對手的攻擊會因憤怒 而大幅提高。

moves.name: Swallow
moves.description: The user restores its HP based on its Stockpile count. Restores 1/4 of its maximum HP if it's 1, 1/2 of its maximum HP if it's 2, both rounded half down, and all of its HP if it's 3. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. The user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.
moves.descriptionZh: 將蓄積的力量吞下， 回復自己的ＨＰ。 蓄積得越多，回復越多。

moves.name: Sweet Kiss
moves.description: Causes the target to become confused.
moves.descriptionZh: 像天使般可愛地親吻對手， 進而使對手混亂。

moves.name: Sweet Scent
moves.description: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 用香氣大幅降低對手的閃避率。

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: This move does not check accuracy.
moves.descriptionZh: 發射星型光線攻擊對手。 攻擊必定會命中。

moves.name: Switcheroo
moves.description: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 以肉眼看不清的速度 將自己和對手的持有物互相交換。

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack by 2 stages.
moves.descriptionZh: 激烈地跳起戰舞提升氣勢， 大幅提高自己的攻擊。

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Delta Stream or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.
moves.descriptionZh: 回復自己的ＨＰ。 回復量會隨著天氣的不同 而有所變化。

moves.name: Syrup Bomb
moves.description: If this move is successful, it causes the target's Speed to be lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn for 3 turns.
moves.descriptionZh: 若此招式成功，則每回合結束時目標速度降低1級，持續3回合。

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 用整個身體 撞向對手進行攻擊。

moves.name: Tail Slap
moves.description: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
moves.descriptionZh: 將堅硬的尾巴 掃向對手進行攻擊。 可連續攻擊２～５次。

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description: For 4 turns, the user and its party members have their Speed doubled. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
moves.descriptionZh: 刮起猛烈的強風， 在４回合內 提高我方全體的速度。

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
moves.descriptionZh: 以驚人的氣勢 撞向對手進行攻擊。 自己也會受到少許傷害。

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.
moves.descriptionZh: 激怒對手。 在３回合內讓對手 只能使出給予傷害的招式。

moves.name: Tearful Look
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 變得淚眼汪汪， 令對手喪失鬥志。 進而降低對手的攻擊和特攻。

moves.name: Teatime
moves.description: All active Pokemon consume their held Berries. This effect is not prevented by substitutes, the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a Berry.
moves.descriptionZh: 舉辦茶會， 在場上的寶可夢都會 吃掉自己攜帶的樹果。

moves.name: Teeter Dance
moves.description: Causes the target to become confused.
moves.descriptionZh: 搖搖晃晃地跳起舞， 讓自己周圍的寶可夢 陷入混亂狀態。

moves.name: Temper Flare
moves.description: Power doubles if the user's last move on the previous turn, including moves called by other moves or those used through Instruct, Magic Coat, Snatch, or the Dancer or Magic Bounce Abilities, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, or Mind Blown, or if the user was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging or Sky Drop. A move that was blocked by Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果使用者上一回合的最後一個動作（包括由其他動作調用的動作或透過指令、魔法外套、抓舉或舞者或魔法彈跳能力使用的動作）未能實現任何正常效果（不包括不成功的跳高踢、跳躍踢或心靈吹散造成的傷害），或者如果使用者被除充能或空間掉落之外的任何力量阻止移動，則加倍。被Baneful Bunker、Detect、King's Shield、Protect、Spiky Shield、Crafty Shield、Mat Block、Quick Guard或Wide Guard阻擋的招式不會使該招式的威力加倍，彈跳或飛行也不會因重力、Smack Down或千支箭的效果而提前結束。

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user is Terastallized, this move becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes, and this move's type becomes the same as the user's Tera Type. In addition, if the user's Tera Type is Stellar, this move has 100 power, is super effective against Terastallized targets and neutral against other targets, and lowers the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 如果使用者被Terastallized，如果使用者的攻擊大於其特殊攻擊（包括統計階段的變化），則此招式將變為物理攻擊，並且此招式的類型將與使用者的Tera類型相同。另外，如果使用者的太拉屬性為恆星，則該招式擁有100點威力，對太拉化目標非常有效，對其他目標則為中立，並且使使用者的攻擊和特攻降低1級。

moves.name: Terrain Pulse
moves.description: Power doubles if the user is grounded and a terrain is active, and this move's type changes to match. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain.
moves.descriptionZh: 藉助場地的力量進行攻擊。 視使出招式時場地狀態不同， 招式的屬性和威力會有所變化。

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: If this attack was successful and the user is not holding an item, it steals the target's held item. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mega Stone and either the user or the target is the species that can Mega Evolve with it. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 在攻擊的同時偷取道具。 當寶可夢自己有攜帶道具時， 則無法偷取。

moves.name: Thrash
moves.description: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
moves.descriptionZh: 在２～３回合內 瘋狂亂打對手進行攻擊。 大鬧一番後自己會陷入混亂。

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves.
moves.descriptionZh: 受到此招式攻擊的對手， 會因為地獄般的痛苦，在２回合內 無法使用會發出聲音的招式。

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手劈下暴雷進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Thunder Fang
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 用蓄滿電流的牙齒咬住對手。 有時會讓對手畏縮 或陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用帶有電流的拳頭 攻擊對手。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 發出電流刺激對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.
moves.descriptionZh: 放出微弱的電流。 讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手放出強力電流進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Tickle
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 搔癢對手的身體，讓對手發笑， 降低對手的攻擊和防禦。

moves.name: Tidy Up
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage. Removes substitutes from all active Pokemon and ends the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes for both sides.
moves.descriptionZh: 使使用者的攻擊力和速度提升1級。從所有活躍的神奇寶貝中刪除替代品，並結束雙方的尖刺、隱形岩石、粘網和有毒尖刺的效果。

moves.name: Topsy-Turvy
moves.description: The target's positive stat stages become negative and vice versa. Fails if all of the target's stat stages are 0.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓對手身上所有的 能力變化顛倒過來， 變成和原來相反的狀態。

moves.name: Torch Song
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 100%機率使自身特攻提升1級。

moves.name: Torment
moves.description: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.
moves.descriptionZh: 無理取鬧， 讓對手不能連續２次 使出相同招式。

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓對手陷入劇毒狀態。 中毒傷害會隨著 回合的進行而增加。

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.description: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, but a substitute does not.
moves.descriptionZh: 在對手腳下散布毒菱。 讓對手替換出場的寶可夢 陷入中毒狀態。

moves.name: Toxic Thread
moves.description: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages and poisons it.
moves.descriptionZh: 使目標速度降低2級並使其中毒。

moves.name: Trailblaze
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 100%機率使用戶速度提升1級。

moves.name: Transform
moves.description: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.
moves.descriptionZh: 變身成對手寶可夢的樣子， 能夠使用和對手 完全相同的招式。

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用３種光線進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入 麻痺、灼傷或冰凍的狀態。

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 在對手露出空隙時， 趁機交換自己和對手的持有物。

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
moves.descriptionZh: 創造出非常不可思議的空間。 在５回合內， 速度慢的寶可夢可以先行動。

moves.name: Trick-or-Treat
moves.description: Causes the Ghost type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Ghost type. If Forest's Curse adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.
moves.descriptionZh: 邀請對手參加萬聖夜。 讓對手追加幽靈屬性。

moves.name: Triple Arrows
moves.description: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage, a 30% chance to make it flinch, and a higher chance for a critical hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 50%機率降低目標1級防禦，30%機率使其退縮，更高機率造成暴擊。

moves.name: Triple Axel
moves.description: Hits three times. Power increases to 40 for the second hit and 60 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.
moves.descriptionZh: 連續踢對手３次進行攻擊。 每踢中一次，威力就會提高。

moves.name: Trop Kick
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 100%機率使目標攻擊降低1級。

moves.name: Twin Beam
moves.description: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
moves.descriptionZh: 擊中兩次。如果第一次擊打破壞了目標的替身，則第二次擊打將對其造成傷害。

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
moves.descriptionZh: 攻擊後迅速返回， 和後備寶可夢進行替換。

moves.name: Upper Hand
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the target did not select a physical or special attack for use this turn with altered priority greater than 0, or if the target moves before the user.
moves.descriptionZh: 有100%的幾率使目標退縮。如果目標本回合沒有選擇物理或特殊攻擊且變更優先順序大於 0，或目標在使用者之前移動，則失敗。

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. On the first of the three turns, all sleeping active Pokemon wake up. During the three turns, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon switched in during the effect do not wake up. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.
moves.descriptionZh: 在３回合內 大吵大鬧攻擊對手。 在此期間誰都無法入眠。

moves.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 揮動拳頭， 捲起真空波。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

moves.name: Venom Drench
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 1 stage if the target is poisoned. Fails if the target is not poisoned.
moves.descriptionZh: 向對手發射特殊的毒液。 陷入中毒狀態的對手 攻擊、特攻和速度會降低。

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.
moves.descriptionZh: 將特殊的毒液潑向對手。 攻擊陷入中毒狀態的對手時， 威力會變成２倍。

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
moves.descriptionZh: 攻擊後迅速返回， 和後備寶可夢進行替換。

moves.name: Volt Tackle
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
moves.descriptionZh: 用電流圍繞全身後猛撞對手。 自己也會受到不小的傷害。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 用水的震動攻擊對手。 有時會使對手混亂。

moves.name: Water Shuriken
moves.description: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is an Ash-Greninja with the Battle Bond Ability, this move has a power of 20 and always hits three times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
moves.descriptionZh: 射出用黏液製成的手裡劍， 連續攻擊２～５次。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

moves.name: Water Spout
moves.description: Power is equal to (user's current HP * 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.
moves.descriptionZh: 噴起潮水進行攻擊。 自己的ＨＰ越少， 招式的威力越小。

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 以驚人的氣勢撲向對手。 有時會讓對手畏縮。

moves.name: Wave Crash
moves.description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
moves.descriptionZh: 若目標失去生命值，使用者將受到相當於目標失去生命值33%的反沖傷害，四捨五入一半，但不低於1生命值。

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description: Power doubles if a weather condition other than Delta Stream is active, and this move's type changes to match. Ice type during Snow, Water type during Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, Rock type during Sandstorm, and Fire type during Desolate Land or Sunny Day. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and uses Weather Ball during Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Desolate Land, or Sunny Day, this move remains Normal type and does not double in power.
moves.descriptionZh: 招式屬性和威力會隨著 使用時天氣的不同而改變。

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
moves.descriptionZh: 將對手困在激烈的 水流漩渦中， 在４～５回合內進行攻擊。

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.description: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.
moves.descriptionZh: 吹飛對手， 強制讓後備寶可夢上場。 對手為野生寶可夢時，戰鬥將直接結束。

moves.name: Wide Guard
moves.description: The user and its party members are protected from moves made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn that target all adjacent foes or all adjacent Pokemon. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
moves.descriptionZh: 在１回合內， 防禦住攻擊我方全體的攻擊招式。

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
moves.descriptionZh: 讓電流圍繞全身， 衝撞對手進行攻擊。 自己也會受到少許傷害。

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.description: Burns the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 放出詭異的火焰， 讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

moves.name: Wing Attack
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 用大大伸展開來的美麗翅膀， 撞向對手進行攻擊。

moves.name: Wish
moves.description: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of the user's maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.
moves.descriptionZh: 在下一回合回復自己或是 替換上場的寶可夢最大ＨＰ的一半。

moves.name: Withdraw
moves.description: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 縮入殼中保護身體， 提高自己的防禦。

moves.name: Wonder Room
moves.description: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon have their Defense and Special Defense stats swapped. Stat stage changes are unaffected. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
moves.descriptionZh: 創造出非常不可思議的空間。 在５回合內，讓所有寶可夢的 防禦和特防互相交換。

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
moves.descriptionZh: 用堅硬的軀體 撞擊對手進行攻擊。 自己也會受到不小的傷害。

moves.name: Work Up
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
moves.descriptionZh: 激勵自己， 提高自己的攻擊和特攻。

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.description: Causes the target's Ability to become Insomnia. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Insomnia, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
moves.descriptionZh: 埋下令人心煩意亂的種子， 讓對手睡不著， 將對手的特性變成不眠。

moves.name: Wrap
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
moves.descriptionZh: 使用長長的身體或藤蔓等， 在４～５回合內 緊束對手進行攻擊。

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: No additional effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 將鐮刀或爪子像剪刀般地交叉， 順勢劈開對手。

moves.name: Yawn
moves.description: Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.
moves.descriptionZh: 打個大哈欠引起睡意。 在下一回合 讓對手陷入睡眠狀態。

moves.name: Zap Cannon
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.
moves.descriptionZh: 發射如大炮般的 電流進行攻擊。 能讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
moves.descriptionZh: 將意念的力量集中在 前額進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手畏縮。

abilities.name: Stench
abilities.description: This Pokemon's attacks without a chance to make the target flinch gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch.
abilities.descriptionZh: 發出臭氣， 在攻擊的時候， 有時會使對手畏縮。

abilities.name: Drizzle
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Rain Dance.
abilities.descriptionZh: 出場時， 會將天氣變為下雨。

abilities.name: Speed Boost
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage at the end of each full turn it has been on the field.
abilities.descriptionZh: 每一回合速度會變快。

abilities.name: Battle Armor
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.
abilities.descriptionZh: 被堅硬的甲殼守護著， 不會被對手的攻擊擊中要害。

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. OHKO moves fail when used against this Pokemon.
abilities.descriptionZh: 受到對手的招式攻擊時 不會被一擊打倒。 一擊必殺的招式也沒有效果。

abilities.name: Damp
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is active, Explosion, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion, Self-Destruct, and the Aftermath Ability are prevented from having an effect.
abilities.descriptionZh: 透過把周圍都弄濕， 使誰都無法使用自爆等爆炸類的招式。

abilities.name: Limber
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.
abilities.descriptionZh: 因為身體柔軟， 不會陷入麻痺狀態。

abilities.name: Sand Veil
abilities.description: If Sandstorm is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokemon is multiplied by 0.8. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.
abilities.descriptionZh: 在沙暴中 閃避率會提高。

abilities.name: Static
abilities.description: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be paralyzed.
abilities.descriptionZh: 身上帶有靜電， 有時會令接觸到的對手麻痺。

abilities.name: Volt Absorb
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by an Electric-type move.
abilities.descriptionZh: 受到電屬性的招式攻擊時， 不會受到傷害，而是會回復。

abilities.name: Water Absorb
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move.
abilities.descriptionZh: 受到水屬性的招式攻擊時， 不會受到傷害，而是會回復。

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
abilities.descriptionZh: 感覺遲鈍， 不會陷入著迷和被挑釁狀態。

abilities.name: Cloud Nine
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.
abilities.descriptionZh: 任何天氣的影響都會消失。

abilities.name: Compound Eyes
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.3.
abilities.descriptionZh: 因為擁有複眼， 會提高招式的命中率。

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.
abilities.descriptionZh: 因為有著睡不著的體質， 所以不會陷入睡眠狀態。

abilities.name: Immunity
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.
abilities.descriptionZh: 因為體內擁有免疫能力， 不會陷入中毒狀態。

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Fire-type moves. The first time it is hit by a Fire-type move, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack as long as it remains active and has this Ability. If this Pokemon is frozen, it cannot be defrosted by Fire-type attacks.
abilities.descriptionZh: 受到火屬性的招式攻擊時， 吸收火焰，讓自己使出的 火屬性招式變強。

abilities.name: Shield Dust
abilities.description: This Pokemon is not affected by the secondary effect of another Pokemon's attack. Attacks with secondary effects that are prevented include those with a chance (even 100%) to paralyze, sleep, freeze, burn, poison, confuse, cause this Pokemon to flinch, cause this Pokemon's stat stages to be lowered, as well as Anchor Shot, Eerie Spell, Fling, Psychic Noise, Salt Cure, Spirit Shackle, Syrup Bomb, and Throat Chop. The effect of Sparkling Aria is prevented if this Pokemon is the only target. Secondary effects added by King's Rock, Razor Fang, and the Poison Touch, Stench, and Toxic Chain Abilities are also prevented against this Pokemon.
abilities.descriptionZh: 被鱗粉守護著， 不會受到招式的追加效果影響。

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
abilities.descriptionZh: 因為我行我素， 不會陷入混亂狀態。

abilities.name: Suction Cups
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.
abilities.descriptionZh: 用吸盤將自己牢牢吸附在地面上， 讓替換寶可夢的招式和道具失效。

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opposing Pokemon by 1 stage. Pokemon with the Inner Focus, Oblivious, Own Tempo, or Scrappy Abilities and Pokemon behind a substitute are immune.
abilities.descriptionZh: 出場時威嚇對手， 使其退縮， 從而降低對手的攻擊。

abilities.name: Shadow Tag
